properties.description: Refreshing the mict_moves_time_delta pipeline for JobExecution report.
This pipeline runs the bronze to Silver layer data loading and Rehandles Logic
GPA storage trigger for Work Instructions data
MICT storage Event Trigger for WI pipeline
Work instruction storage event trigger for malta

typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		GKEY as string,
		UYV_GKEY as string,
		UNIT_ID as string,
		DECKING_TYPE as string,
		NODE_ID as string,
		YARD as string,
		FROM_POS_LOCTYPE as string,
		FROM_POS_LOCID as string,

		FROM_POS_TIER as string,
		TO_POS_LOCTYPE as string,
		TO_POS_LOCID as string,
		TO_POS_LOC_GKEY as string,
		TO_POS_SLOT as string,
		TO_POS_NAME as string,
		TO_POS_BIN as string,
		TO_POS_TIER as string,
		TOTAL_SCORE as string,
		EXECUTION_TIME as string,
		PHASE as string,
		TIME_STAMP as string
	),
	useSchema: false,
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	moveFiles: ['bronze/deckinghistory/load','bronze/deckinghistory/archive'],
	format: 'delimited',
	fileSystem: 'bhct',
	folderPath: 'bronze/deckinghistory/load',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	columnNamesAsHeader: true,
	dateFormats: ['dd-MM-yyyy'],
	timestampFormats: ['yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\'','yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss\'Z\''],
	mode: 'read') ~> CSV
Aggregate1 derive(time_stamp = :timestamp,
		Year = year(:timestamp),
		Month = month(:timestamp),
		Week = weekOfYear(:timestamp),
		timestamp := coalesce(toTimestamp(split(time_stamp,".")[1],'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(split(time_stamp,".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(split(time_stamp,".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'),toTimestamp(split(time_stamp,".")[1],'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'))) ~> DataTypeConversion
Select2 select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			regexReplace($$,' ','_') = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 aggregate(groupBy(gkey),
	each(match(name!='gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
CSV select(mapColumn(
		gkey = GKEY,
		uyv_gkey = UYV_GKEY,
		unit_id = UNIT_ID,
		time_stamp = TIME_STAMP,
		decking_type = DECKING_TYPE,
		node_id = NODE_ID,
		yard = YARD,
		from_pos_loctype = FROM_POS_LOCTYPE,
		from_pos_locid = FROM_POS_LOCID,
		from_pos_loc_gkey = FROM_POS_LOC_GKEY,
		from_pos_slot = FROM_POS_SLOT,
		from_pos_name = FROM_POS_NAME,
		from_pos_bin = FROM_POS_BIN,
		from_pos_tier = FROM_POS_TIER,
		from_pos_loctype = FROM_POS_LOCTYPE,
		to_pos_locid = TO_POS_LOCID,
		to_pos_loctype = TO_POS_LOCTYPE,
		to_pos_loc_gkey = TO_POS_LOC_GKEY,
		to_pos_slot = TO_POS_SLOT,
		to_pos_name = TO_POS_NAME,
		to_pos_bin = TO_POS_BIN,
		to_pos_tier = TO_POS_TIER,
		total_score = TOTAL_SCORE,
		execution_time = EXECUTION_TIME,
		phase = PHASE
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
filter1 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
DataTypeConversion filter(not(isNull(gkey)) && not(isNull(time_stamp))) ~> filter1
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'bhct',
	folderPath: 'silver/deckings',
	mergeSchema: false,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['gkey'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('key',
		0,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week
	)) ~> sink2

scriptLines: select2 filter(not(isNull(ecEventGkey)) && cheKind=="ITV" && (eventTypeDescription=="AYCO" || eventTypeDescription=="TVDR" || eventTypeDescription=="AVDR" || eventTypeDescription=="AVCO" || eventTypeDescription=="TYDR" || eventTypeDescription=="AYDR" ) && (moveKind=="DSCH"||moveKind=="LOAD")) ~> filter1
iif((eventTypeDescription_nxt != 'AVDR' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_nxt)) && (eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AYCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag)), 'Miss at Vessel and Row',
iif(eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AYCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag), 'Load-Miss Arrive at Row', 'No Violation'))),
iif((eventTypeDescription_nxt != 'AYDR' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_nxt)) && (eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AVCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag)), 'Miss at Vessel and Row',
iif(eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AVCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag), 'DSCH-Miss Arrive at Vessel', 'No Violation'))),
RTG_Type = iif(in(:ARTG_ids, cheName) , "ARTG", iif(in(:Manual_RTG_ids, cheName), "Manual_RTG", iif(startsWith(cheName, "ARMG"), "ARMG", ""))),
join1 filter(From_Location != 'YARD' && Unit_Nbr != '' && not(isNull(Unit_Nbr))  && !startsWith(split(To_Position_Name, "-")[3], 'CR') && t_put > addDays(time_stamp, -15)) ~> filter2
join2 derive({Location Match or Not} = iif(substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 6) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 6), 'Position Followed', 'Position Not Followed'),

select2 filter(not(isNull(gkey)) && (decking_Type == 'Bump Intruder' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge - Twin' || decking_Type == 'XD Drop if Floating Refine' || decking_Type == 'XD Refine Request' || decking_Type == 'XD Rehandle Request')) ~> filter5

Same_Block_Violation = iif( (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 2) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 2)) && (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 3, 3) != substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 3, 3)), true(), false()),

Stack_Violation = iif(substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 5) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 5) && substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 6, 1) != substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 6, 1), true(), false())) ~> derivedColumn6

		fm_pos_gkey as integer,
		Restow_Reason as string,
		Container_Line_Id as string,
		Container_Line_Role as string,
		pow as string,
		mve_gkey as long,
		ufv_gkey as long,
		Berth_Id as string,
		Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg as double,
		active_ufv as long,
		Requires_Power_Flag as string,
		OOG_Flag as string,
		Shipper_Id as string,
		Consignee_Id as string,
		Commodity_Id as string,
		ATD as timestamp,
		Rehandles as short,
		Year as integer,
		Month as integer,
		Week as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'gti',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves') ~> source1
source1 filter(Event_Type_Id=="UNIT_DISCH" || Event_Type_Id == "UNIT_LOAD") ~> Filter1
Filter1 derive(Time_Completed_Date_Time = iif(Event_Type_Id== "UNIT_LOAD", iifNull(t_put,t_carry_complete),iifNull(t_fetch,t_discharge))) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 derive(Time = toString(Time_Completed_Date_Time,'HH:mm:ss'),
		Date = toDate(toString(Time_Completed_Date_Time,'yyyy-MM-dd'))) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 aggregate(groupBy(Carrier_Visit_Key,
		pow,
		Date),
	First_Lift = min(Time_Completed_Date_Time),
		Last_Lift = max(Time_Completed_Date_Time),
		Move_Count = countDistinct(mve_gkey)) ~> Aggregate1
Aggregate1 derive(WorkTime = Last_Lift-First_Lift,
		Year = iifNull(year(Date),0),
		Month = iifNull(month(Date),0),
		Week = iifNull(weekOfYear(Date),0)) ~> DerivedColumn4
DerivedColumn4 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'gti',
	folderPath: 'gold/qc_cmph',
	mergeSchema: true,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['Carrier_Visit_Key','pow','Date'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('key',
		0,
		Year,
		Month,
		Week
	)) ~> sink1

scriptLines: derivedColumn1 derive(ShiftStartTime = toTimestamp(         toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' +         iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     ),

ShiftEndTime = toTimestamp(         toString(             iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ) + ' ' +         iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     )) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn1 derive(ShiftStartTime = toTimestamp(         toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' +         iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '07:00:00', '19:00:00'),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     ),

ShiftEndTime = toTimestamp(         toString(             iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ) + ' ' +         iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '18:59:59', '06:59:59'),         'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'     )) ~> derivedColumn2
derivedColumn2 filter(iif(moveKind=="DSCH", (cheKind=="ITV" || cheKind=="QC"), iif(moveKind=="LOAD", (cheKind=="RTG" || cheKind=="QC"),false()))) ~> filter1
ecevents filter(eventTypeDescription=='CMPL'&& (cheKind=='RTG' || cheKind=='ITV' || cheKind=='QC') && not(isNull(EcEventTime))) ~> filter2

	Carry_CHE_Id_PREV = lag(Carry_CHE_Id),

		t_put_PREV = lag(t_put),

join1 derive(Effective_Unladen_Distance = iif(
    isNull(dist_start)
    || toDouble(dist_start) <= 0,

    dist_start_AVG,

    toDouble(dist_start)
),
		Effective_Laden_Distance = iif(
    isNull(dist_carry)
    || toDouble(dist_carry) <= 0,

    dist_carry_AVG,

)) ~> derivedColumn1

		dist_carry = iif(dist_carry==100000000,0,dist_carry),

	&& aggregate1@Event_Type_Id == aggregate2@Event_Type_Id,
	joinType:'left',

	),

split1@Load derive(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec = iif(
    !isNull(t_carry_fetch_ready)
    && !isNull(t_fetch),

    (toLong(t_fetch) - toLong(t_carry_fetch_ready)) / 1000,

    toLong(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn4
split1@Dsch derive(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec = iif(
    !isNull(t_carry_put_ready)
    && !isNull(t_put),

    (toLong(t_put) - toLong(t_carry_put_ready)) / 1000,

    toLong(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn5
derivedColumn5 derive(Fallback_Wait = iif(
    isNull(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec)
    && !isNull(t_put)
    && !isNull(t_discharge),

    (
        (toLong(t_put) - toLong(t_discharge))/1000
    )
    -
    (
        Estimated_Laden_Travel_Sec
    ),

    toDouble(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn6
derivedColumn4 derive(Fallback_Wait = iif(
    isNull(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec)
    && !isNull(t_fetch)
    && !isNull(t_carry_dispatch),

    (
        (toLong(t_fetch) - toLong(t_carry_dispatch))/1000
    )
    -
    (
        Estimated_Unladen_Travel_Sec
    ),

    toDouble(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn7
derivedColumn6 derive(prev_fallback = iif(
    isNull(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec)
    && isNull(Fallback_Wait)
    && !isNull(t_carry_complete_PREV)
    && !isNull(t_put),

    (
        (toLong(t_put) - toLong(t_carry_complete_PREV))/1000
    )
    -
    (
        Estimated_Unladen_Travel_Sec
        +
        Estimated_Laden_Travel_Sec
    ),

    toDouble(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn8
derivedColumn7 derive(prev_fallback = iif(
    isNull(Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec)
    && isNull(Fallback_Wait)
    && !isNull(t_carry_complete_PREV)
    && !isNull(t_fetch),

    (
        (toLong(t_fetch) - toLong(t_carry_complete_PREV))/1000
    )
    -
    Estimated_Unladen_Travel_Sec,

    toDouble(null())
)) ~> derivedColumn9
derivedColumn9 derive(Wait_Time_Sec = coalesce(
    Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec,
    Fallback_Wait,
    prev_fallback
)) ~> derivedColumn10
derivedColumn8 derive(Wait_Time_Sec = coalesce(
    Direct_RTG_Wait_Sec,
    Fallback_Wait,
    prev_fallback
)) ~> derivedColumn11
derivedColumn10, derivedColumn11 union(byName: true)~> union2
union2 derive(Idle_Time_Sec = iif(
    !isNull(t_carry_complete_PREV)
    &&
    !isNull(t_carry_complete)
    &&
    toLong(t_carry_complete)
        >= toLong(t_carry_complete_PREV),

    (
        (
            toLong(t_carry_complete)
            -
            toLong(t_carry_complete_PREV)
        ) / 1000
    )

    -

    coalesce(Estimated_Unladen_Travel_Sec,0)

    -

    coalesce(Estimated_Laden_Travel_Sec,0),

    toDouble(null())
),
		Travel_Time_Sec = coalesce(Estimated_Unladen_Travel_Sec,0)
+
coalesce(Estimated_Laden_Travel_Sec,0)) ~> derivedColumn12
derivedColumn12 derive(Wait_Time_Sec = iif(
    Wait_Time_Sec < 0
    || Wait_Time_Sec > 7200
    || isNull(Wait_Time_Sec),

    toLong(0),

    toLong(Wait_Time_Sec)
),
		Idle_Time_Sec = iif(
    Idle_Time_Sec < 0
    || Idle_Time_Sec > 14400
    || isNull(Idle_Time_Sec),

    toLong(0),

    toLong(Idle_Time_Sec)
)) ~> derivedColumn13

iif((eventTypeDescription_nxt != 'AVDR' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_nxt)) && (eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AYCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag)), 'Miss at Vessel and Row',
iif(eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AYCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag), 'Load-Miss Arrive at Row', 'No Violation'))),
iif((eventTypeDescription_nxt != 'AYDR' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_nxt)) && (eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AVCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag)), 'Miss at Vessel and Row',
iif(eventTypeDescription_lag != 'AVCO' || isNull(eventTypeDescription_lag), 'DSCH-Miss Arrive at Vessel', 'No Violation'))),
join1 filter(From_Location != 'YARD' && Unit_Nbr != '' && not(isNull(Unit_Nbr))  && !startsWith(split(To_Position_Name, "-")[3], 'CR') && t_put > addDays(time_stamp, -15)) ~> filter2
derivedColumn3 filter(DH_timestamp_within_4 == 1 && DH_To_Position_Name_Short != "FAIL TO DECK" && not(like(DH_To_Position_Name_Short, "Fail%"))) ~> filter3

{Location Match or Not} = iif(left(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, length(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5) - 1) == left(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, length(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5) - 1), 'Position Followed', 'Position Not Followed'),

select2 filter(not(isNull(gkey)) && (decking_Type == 'Bump Intruder' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge - Twin' || decking_Type == 'Gate Receival Assign Position' || decking_Type == 'XD Drop if Floating Refine' || decking_Type == 'XD Refine Request' || decking_Type == 'XD Rehandle Request')) ~> filter5
join6 derive(Block_To_Block_Violation = iif(MH_Block != DH_Block, true(), false()),
Same_Block_Violation = iif( MH_Block == DH_Block && MH_Section != DH_Section , true(), false()),
Stack_Violation = iif( MH_Block == DH_Block && MH_Section == DH_Section && MH_Stack != DH_Stack, true(), false())) ~> derivedColumn6

iif(POW_PREV==pow && Vessel_Code==Vessel_PREV,minus(Move_Completion_Date_Time,Move_Completion_Date_Time_PREV)/60000,toLong(0))>15

Same_Block_Violation = iif( (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 3) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 3)) && (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 5, 2) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 5, 2)), false(), true()),
join1 filter(From_Location != 'YARD' && Unit_Nbr != '' && not(isNull(Unit_Nbr)) && !startsWith(split(To_Position_Name, "-")[3], 'CR') && t_put > addDays(time_stamp, -15)) ~> filter2
join2 derive({Location Match or Not} = iif(substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 6) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 6), 'Position Followed', 'Position Not Followed'),

select2 filter(not(isNull(gkey)) && (decking_Type == 'Bump Intruder' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge' || decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge - Twin' || decking_Type == 'XD Drop if Floating Refine' || decking_Type == 'XD Refine Request' || decking_Type == 'XD Rehandle Request')) ~> filter5

Same_Block_Violation = iif( (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 3) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 1, 3)) && (substring(MH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 5, 2) == substring(DH_To_Position_Name_Short_5, 5, 2)), false(), true()),
{Goods And Ctr Wt Kg} as integer,
mh_time := coalesce(toTimestamp(split({MH T_Put DateTime},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(split({MH T_Put DateTime},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))) ~> derivedColumn1

aggregate2 filter(Decking_Type == 'Bump Intruder' || Decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge' || Decking_Type == 'Vessel Discharge - Twin' || Decking_Type == 'XD Drop if Floating Refine' || Decking_Type == 'XD Refine Request' || Decking_Type == 'XD Rehandle Request') ~> filter1
{DH TimeStamp} = coalesce(toTimestamp(split({DH TimeStamp},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(split({DH TimeStamp},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')),
dh_time := coalesce(toTimestamp(split({DH TimeStamp},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(split({DH TimeStamp},".")[1],'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'))) ~> derivedColumn2

		ATA as timestamp,

		Rehandles as string,
		Year as integer,
		Month as integer,
		Week as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'mundra-ct03',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves') ~> source1
source1 filter(equals(Carry_CHE_Kind,'ITV')) ~> Filter1
Filter1 derive(CarryCompleteTime = toString(:CompletionTime,'HH:mm:ss'),
		CarryCompleteDate = toDate(toString(:CompletionTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd')),
		CarryCompleteHour = toInteger(split(toString(:CompletionTime,'HH:mm:ss'),":")[1]),
		WorkingShift = iif(toInteger(split(toString(:CompletionTime,'HH:mm:ss'),":")[1]) >= 8 && toInteger(split(toString(:CompletionTime,'HH:mm:ss'),":")[1]) < 20, 'Shift 1', 'Shift 2'),
		ShiftDate = iif(toInteger(split(toString(:CompletionTime,'HH:mm:ss'),":")[1]) < 8, 
    addDays(toDate(toString(:CompletionTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd')), -1), 
    toDate(toString(:CompletionTime, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))),
		CompletionTime = :CompletionTime,
		CompletionTime := iif(isNull(t_carry_complete),t_put, t_carry_complete)) ~> DerivedColumn2
derivedColumn5 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
DerivedColumn2 sort(asc(Carry_CHE_Id, true),
	asc(CompletionTime, true)) ~> sort1
sort1 select(mapColumn(
		Carry_CHE_Id,
		CarryCompleteDate,
		ShiftDate,
		CarryCompleteHour,
		WorkingShift,
		pow,
		Move_Kind,
		Unit_Nbr,
		mve_gkey,
		dist_carry,
		dist_start
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,

		CarryCompleteHour,

	dummy = count(1),

		CarryCompleteHour,
		WorkingShift,
		pow,
		Move_Kind,
		count_of_moves,
		count_of_trips,
		dist_carry_total,
		dist_start_total
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select2

		ShiftDate,
		WorkingShift),
	asc(CompletionTime, true),
	asc(mve_gkey, true),
	NextMoveTime = lead(CompletionTime,1),
		SecondNextMoveTime = lead(CompletionTime,2)) ~> window1
window1 derive(IdlePeriod_3Hrs = iif(
    isNull(NextMoveTime),
    toLong(0),
    iif(
        toLong(NextMoveTime - CompletionTime) <= 0,
        toLong(0),
         toLong(NextMoveTime - CompletionTime)
        )
        )) ~> derivedColumn1
derivedColumn1 aggregate(groupBy(Carry_CHE_Id,
		ShiftDate,
		WorkingShift),
	First_Lift_Raw = min(CompletionTime),
		Last_Lift_Raw = max(CompletionTime),
		Move_Count = countDistinct(mve_gkey),
		Move_Count_AdjustedforTwinLift = sum(iif(in(['TRUE', 'YES'], upper(Twin_Carry)), 0.5, 1.0)),
		TotalIdleTime = sumIf(IdlePeriod_3Hrs > 10800000, IdlePeriod_3Hrs)) ~> aggregate3
aggregate3 derive(ShiftStartTime = toTimestamp(
		toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' + 
		iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),
		'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
	),
		ShiftEndTime = toTimestamp( toString( iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),'yyyy-MM-dd' ) + ' ' +  	iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'), 
		'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' 	),
		First_Lift = iif(
    toLong(First_Lift_Raw - toTimestamp(
        toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' + 
        iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),
        'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
    )) > 10800000,
    First_Lift_Raw,      
    toTimestamp(         
        toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' + 
        iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),
        'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
    )
),
		Last_Lift = iif(
		toLong(
			toTimestamp(
				toString(
					iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),
					'yyyy-MM-dd'
				) + ' ' + 
				iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'),
				'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
			) - Last_Lift_Raw
		) > 10800000,
		Last_Lift_Raw,
		toTimestamp(
			toString(
				iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),
				'yyyy-MM-dd'
			) + ' ' + 
			iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'),
			'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
		)
	),
		Time_From_ShiftStart = iif(
		toLong(First_Lift_Raw - toTimestamp(
			toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' + 
			iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),
			'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
		)) < 0,
		toLong(0),
		toLong(First_Lift_Raw - toTimestamp(
			toString(ShiftDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' ' + 
			iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '08:00:00', '20:00:00'),
			'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
		))
	),
		Time_To_ShiftEnd = iif(
		toLong(toTimestamp(
			toString(
				iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),
				'yyyy-MM-dd'
			) + ' ' + 
			iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'),
			'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
		) - Last_Lift_Raw) < 0,
		toLong(0),
		toLong(toTimestamp(
			toString(
				iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', ShiftDate, addDays(ShiftDate, 1)),
				'yyyy-MM-dd'
			) + ' ' + 
			iif(WorkingShift == 'Shift 1', '19:59:59', '07:59:59'),
			'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'
		) - Last_Lift_Raw)
	)) ~> derivedColumn3
derivedColumn4 derive(WorkTime = iif(
    First_Lift_Raw == Last_Lift_Raw,
    Single_Move_WorkTime,
    iif(
        toLong(Last_Lift - First_Lift) - iifNull(TotalIdleTime, toLong(0)) < 0,
        toLong(0),
        toLong(Last_Lift - First_Lift) - iifNull(TotalIdleTime, toLong(0))
    )
),
		Raw_WorkTime = toLong(Last_Lift - First_Lift) - iifNull(TotalIdleTime, toLong(0)),
		Year = iifNull(year(ShiftDate),0),
		Month = iifNull(month(ShiftDate),0),
		Is_Negative = (toLong(Last_Lift - First_Lift) - iifNull(TotalIdleTime, toLong(0))) < 0,
		Is_Single_Move = First_Lift_Raw == Last_Lift_Raw) ~> derivedColumn5
derivedColumn3 derive(Single_Move_WorkTime = iif(
		First_Lift_Raw == Last_Lift_Raw,
		iif(
			Time_From_ShiftStart == 0 && Time_To_ShiftEnd == 0,
			toLong(3600000),  
			iif(
				Time_From_ShiftStart < Time_To_ShiftEnd && Time_From_ShiftStart > 0,
				Time_From_ShiftStart,
				iif(
					Time_To_ShiftEnd > 0,
					Time_To_ShiftEnd,
					toLong(3600000) 
				)
			)
		),
		toLong(0)
	)) ~> derivedColumn4

source(output(

		ORIGIN_ACCESS_TEXT as string,
		DEST_ACCESS_ENUM as string,
		DEST_ACCESS_TEXT as string,
		SYS_PATH_MESSAGE as string,
		EXECUTION_NOTE as string,
		CONFIRMER as string,
		CONFIRMED as string,
		DISPATCHED as string,
		CANCELER as string,
		CANCELED as string,
		COMPLETED as string
	),
	useSchema: false,
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	moveFiles: ['bronze/lanechange/load','bronze/lanechange/archive'],
	format: 'delimited',
	fileSystem: 'malta',
	folderPath: 'bronze/lanechange/load',
	columnDelimiter: ',',
	escapeChar: '\\',
	quoteChar: '\"',
	columnNamesAsHeader: true,
	dateFormats: ['dd-MM-yyyy'],
	timestampFormats: ['yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss.SSS\'Z\'','yyyy-MM-dd\'T\'HH:mm:ss\'Z\'']) ~> CSV
Aggregate1 derive(created = coalesce(toTimestamp(created,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(created,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(created,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(created,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		confirmed = coalesce(toTimestamp(confirmed,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(confirmed,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(confirmed,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(confirmed,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		dispatched = coalesce(toTimestamp(dispatched,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(dispatched,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(dispatched,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(dispatched,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		canceled = coalesce(toTimestamp(canceled,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(canceled,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(canceled,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(canceled,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')),
		completed = coalesce(toTimestamp(completed,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(completed,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm'),toTimestamp(completed,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss'),toTimestamp(completed,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'))) ~> DataTypeConversion
CSV select(mapColumn(
		each(match(true()),
			lower(regexReplace($$,' ','_')) = $$)
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 aggregate(groupBy(gkey),
	each(match(name!='gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> Aggregate1
select2 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
DataTypeConversion derive(createdDate = toDate(created),
		creatorType = iif(
    left(creator,4)=='yc_b',
    'System',
    'User'
),
		shift = iif(
    hour(created)>=6 && hour(created)<18,
    'Day',
    'Night'
),
		consider = iif((toDate(created)<= toDate("14-06-2026", "dd-MM-yyyy")),
iif(
    instr(sys_path_message,'XA')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XB')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XC')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XD')>0,
    'No',
    'Yes'
),
/* iif(
    instr(sys_path_message,'XA1')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XA2')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XA3')>0 ||
    instr(sys_path_message,'XA4')>0,
    'No',
    'Yes'
) */
"Yes"
),
		cancellorType = iif(
    isNull(canceler) || trim(canceler)=='',
    '',
    iif(
        left(canceler,4)=='-sys',
        'System',
        'User'
    )
)) ~> derivedColumn1

		canceled,
		completed,
		createdDate,
		creatorType,
		shift,
		consider,
		cancellorType
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select2

        ('3M','T2'),('3N','T1'),('3P','T2'),('3Q','T2'),
        ('3R','T1'),('3S','T2'),('3T','T2'),('3V','T2'),
        ('3Y','T2'),('3Z','T2'),('4A','T1'),('4B','T1'),
        ('4C','T1'),('4N','T2'),('5N','T2'),('CZ','T2'),
        ('GD','T1'),('GE','T1'),('GF','T1'),('KD','T2'),
        ('SC','T1'),('WA','T1'),('WB','T1'),('WC','T2'),
        ('WE','T2'),('XA','T1'),('XB','T1'),('XC','T1'),
        ('XD','T1'),('XE','T1'),('XF','T1'),('XG','T1'),
        ('XH','T1'),('XJ','T1'),('XK','T1'),('XL','T1'),
        ('XM','T1'),('XR','T1'),('PA','T1'),('1N','T1'),

    ) AS y (YardBlock, TerminalShort)
),

enriched AS (
    SELECT
        m.mve_gkey,
        m.Unit_Nbr,
        m.Event_Type_Id,
        m.t_put,
        m.Carrier_Visit_Key,

                    -

        END                             AS From_YardBlock,

                        m.To_Position_Name + ' ',

                            CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name) + 1) + 1)

                        CHARINDEX('-', m.To_Position_Name) + 1) - 1
                 )
            ELSE NULL
        END                             AS To_YardBlock

    FROM OPENROWSET(
            BULK 'silver/moves',
            DATA_SOURCE = 'malta',
            FORMAT = 'DELTA'
         ) AS m
    WHERE m.[Year]        >= 2026
    AND   m.Category_Id   = 'TRSHP'
    AND   m.Event_Type_Id IN ('UNIT_DISCH', 'UNIT_LOAD')
),

enriched_with_terminals AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        c.TerminalShort                 AS Crane_Terminal,
        yf.TerminalShort                AS From_Terminal,
        yt.TerminalShort                AS To_Terminal
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN Cranes     c  ON e.pow            = c.CraneId
    LEFT JOIN Yardblocks yf ON e.From_YardBlock = yf.YardBlock
    LEFT JOIN Yardblocks yt ON e.To_YardBlock   = yt.YardBlock
),

trshp_moves AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Unit_Nbr
            ORDER BY t_put ASC
        )                               AS move_seq
    FROM enriched_with_terminals
),

disch AS (
    SELECT * FROM trshp_moves
    WHERE Event_Type_Id = 'UNIT_DISCH'
),

load AS (
    SELECT * FROM trshp_moves
    WHERE Event_Type_Id = 'UNIT_LOAD'
),

paired AS (
    SELECT
        d.Unit_Nbr,
        d.mve_gkey                      AS disch_mve_gkey,
        d.pow                           AS disch_pow,
        l.pow                           AS load_pow,
        l.mve_gkey                      AS load_mve_gkey,

        -- Discharge details
        d.t_put              AS disch_datetime,
        d.Carrier_Visit_Key             AS disch_vessel,
        d.Crane_Terminal                AS disch_crane_terminal,
        d.To_Terminal                   AS disch_yard_terminal,
        d.To_YardBlock                  AS disch_yard_block,

        -- Load details
        l.t_put              AS load_datetime,
        l.Carrier_Visit_Key             AS load_vessel,
        l.Crane_Terminal                AS load_crane_terminal,
        l.From_Terminal                 AS load_yard_terminal,
        l.From_YardBlock                AS load_yard_block,

        d.Freight_Kind_Id,

        -- Dwell time in hours
        DATEDIFF(HOUR,
            d.t_put,
            l.t_put
        )                               AS dwell_hours,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.Unit_Nbr
            ORDER BY d.t_put ASC
        )                               AS tranship_sequence

    FROM disch d
    INNER JOIN load l
        ON  d.Unit_Nbr = l.Unit_Nbr
        AND l.move_seq = (
            SELECT MIN(l2.move_seq)
            FROM load l2
            WHERE l2.Unit_Nbr = d.Unit_Nbr
            AND   l2.move_seq > d.move_seq
        )
)

SELECT
    p.*,

    CASE
        WHEN p.disch_crane_terminal <> p.load_crane_terminal
        THEN 'Cross-Terminal'
        ELSE 'Same-Terminal'
    END                                 AS tranship_type,

    p.disch_crane_terminal + ' → ' + p.load_crane_terminal
                                        AS terminal_flow,

    CAST(p.disch_datetime AS DATE)      AS disch_date,
    CAST(p.load_datetime  AS DATE)      AS load_date,
    YEAR(p.disch_datetime)              AS disch_year,
    MONTH(p.disch_datetime)             AS disch_month,
    DATENAME(MONTH, p.disch_datetime)   AS disch_month_name,
    FORMAT(p.disch_datetime, 'yyyy-MM') AS disch_year_month

FROM paired p;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE ExecuteR1Query AS
BEGIN
    -- R1 Query Logic
    WITH NextEvent AS (
        SELECT x1.cheID,
               x1.operatorName,
               x1.typeDescription AS EcEventType,
               x1.EcEventTime,
               x1.ecEventGkey,
               x1.Year,
               x1.Month,
               x1.Week,
               x2.operatorName AS NextOperator,
               x2.typeDescription AS NextEcEvent,
               x2.EcEventTime AS NextEcEventEcEventTime,
               CASE 
                   WHEN x1.typeDescription = x2.typeDescription THEN 'NO' 
                   ELSE 'YES'
               END AS CorrectCycle,
                (SELECT TOP 1 ime.t_put
                FROM dbo.move_history ime
                WHERE (ime.Fetch_CHE_Id = x1.cheID or ime.Put_CHE_Id = x1.cheID)
                    AND ime.t_put < x2.EcEventTime
                ORDER BY ime.t_put DESC)
               AS LastMoveEventEcEventTime,
			   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x2.cheID ORDER BY x2.EcEventTime ASC) as row_num
        FROM dbo.ecevents x1
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ecevents x2
		ON x1.cheID = x2.cheID
        AND x2.EcEventTime > x1.EcEventTime
        WHERE x1.typeDescription = 'LGON'
        AND x2.typeDescription IN ('LGON', 'LGOF')
		AND x1.cheKind Like 'RTG%'
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.EquipmentRunningHours
    SELECT
        ne.ecEventGkey,
        ne.cheID,
        ne.operatorName,
        ne.EcEventType,
        ne.EcEventTime,
        ne.NextOperator,
        ne.NextEcEvent,
        ne.NextEcEventEcEventTime,
        ne.CorrectCycle,
        ne.LastMoveEventEcEventTime,
        CASE
            WHEN ne.CorrectCycle = 'YES' 
            THEN DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ne.EcEventTime, ne.NextEcEventEcEventTime) / 60.0
            ELSE DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ne.EcEventTime, ne.LastMoveEventEcEventTime) / 60.0
        END AS TotalWorkinghrs,
        ne.Year,
        ne.Month,
        ne.Week
    FROM NextEvent ne
	WHERE row_num = 1
    ORDER BY ne.cheID, ne.EcEventTime;
END;

# Import required libraries
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

# Parameters
customer = 'cwit'  # Can be parameterized
base_path = f"abfss://{customer}@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net"

# 1. LOAD MOVE HISTORY DATA FROM SILVER LAYER
# ============================================
moves_df = spark.read \
    .format("delta") \
    .load(f"{base_path}/silver/moves")

# Display schema and sample data
# print("Original Data Schema:")
# moves_df.printSchema()
# print(f"Total records: {moves_df.count()}")
# display(moves_df.limit(5))

# 2. FILTER FOR RTG MOVES WITH VALID mve_gkey AND t_put
# ======================================================
rtg_moves_df = moves_df.filter(
    (F.col("mve_gkey").isNotNull()) & 
    (F.col("t_put").isNotNull()) &  # Only include records with valid t_put
    (
        (F.col("Fetch_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") | 
        (F.col("Carry_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") | 
        (F.col("Put_CHE_Kind") == "RTG")
    )
)

# print(f"RTG moves with valid mve_gkey and t_put: {rtg_moves_df.count()}")

# 4. ADD Move_Kind_Actual COLUMN - SIMPLIFIED LOGIC
# =================================================
rtg_moves_with_actual = rtg_moves_df.withColumn(
    "from_has_q", has_q_start(F.col("From_Position_Name"))
).withColumn(
    "from_has_w", has_w(F.col("From_Position_Name"))
).withColumn(
    "to_has_w", has_w(F.col("To_Position_Name"))
).withColumn(
    "to_has_q", has_q_start(F.col("To_Position_Name"))
).withColumn(
    "Move_Kind_Actual",
    F.when(
        # Keep original LOAD as is
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "LOAD"),
        "LOAD"
    ).when(
        # YARD move from Q position to W position = DSCH
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD") & 
        (F.col("from_has_w") == True) & 
        (F.col("to_has_w") == False) &
        (F.col("to_has_q") == False),
        "DSCH"
    ).when(
        # YARD move from Q position to W position = DSCH
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD") & 
        (F.col("Put_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") &
        (F.col("from_has_q") == True) & 
        (F.col("to_has_w") == False),
        "DSCH"    
    ).when(
        # YARD move from W position = DSCH_SECONDARY
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD") & 
        (F.col("from_has_q") == True) &
        (F.col("to_has_w") == True),
        "YARD_DSCH"
    ).when(
        # YARD move to W position (and not from Q) = LOAD_PREPARATORY
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD") & 
        (F.col("to_has_w") == True) & 
        (F.col("from_has_q") == False),
        "YARD_LOAD"
    ).when(
        # All other YARD moves
        (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD"),
        "YARD"
    ).otherwise(F.col("Move_Kind"))  # Keep original for all other move types
)

# Drop helper columns
rtg_moves_with_actual = rtg_moves_with_actual.drop("from_has_q", "from_has_w", "to_has_w","to_has_q")

# Add move_date based on t_put
rtg_moves_with_actual = rtg_moves_with_actual.withColumn(
    "move_date", F.to_date("t_put")

# 5. OPTIMIZED ACTIVE TIME CALCULATION PER CHE PER DAY
# =====================================================
# Cache the main dataframe for better performance
rtg_moves_with_actual.cache()

# Create a more efficient single dataframe for all CHE moves
che_moves_list = []

# Collect Fetch CHE moves
if "Fetch_CHE_Id" in rtg_moves_with_actual.columns:
    fetch_che = rtg_moves_with_actual.filter(
        (F.col("Fetch_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") & F.col("Fetch_CHE_Id").isNotNull()
    ).select(
        "mve_gkey",
        F.col("Fetch_CHE_Id").alias("CHE_Id"),
        "t_put",
        "move_date",
        F.lit("fetch").alias("che_type")
    )
    che_moves_list.append(fetch_che)

# Collect Carry CHE moves
if "Carry_CHE_Id" in rtg_moves_with_actual.columns:
    carry_che = rtg_moves_with_actual.filter(
        (F.col("Carry_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") & F.col("Carry_CHE_Id").isNotNull()
    ).select(
        "mve_gkey",
        F.col("Carry_CHE_Id").alias("CHE_Id"),
        "t_put",
        "move_date",
        F.lit("carry").alias("che_type")
    )
    che_moves_list.append(carry_che)

# Collect Put CHE moves
if "Put_CHE_Id" in rtg_moves_with_actual.columns:
    put_che = rtg_moves_with_actual.filter(
        (F.col("Put_CHE_Kind") == "RTG") & F.col("Put_CHE_Id").isNotNull()
    ).select(
        "mve_gkey",
        F.col("Put_CHE_Id").alias("CHE_Id"),
        "t_put",
        "move_date",
        F.lit("put").alias("che_type")
    )
    che_moves_list.append(put_che)

# Union all CHE moves if we have any
if che_moves_list:
    all_che_moves = che_moves_list[0]
    for df in che_moves_list[1:]:
        all_che_moves = all_che_moves.union(df)
    all_che_moves = all_che_moves.distinct()
else:
    # If no CHE moves found, create empty dataframe with proper schema
    all_che_moves = spark.createDataFrame([], schema="mve_gkey string, CHE_Id long, t_put timestamp, move_date date, che_type string")

# Calculate sessions with 3-hour gap - optimized with single window operation
if all_che_moves.count() > 0:
    che_day_window = Window.partitionBy("CHE_Id", "move_date").orderBy("t_put")
    
    che_sessions = all_che_moves.withColumn(
        "prev_move_time", F.lag("t_put").over(che_day_window)
    ).withColumn(
        "moves_gap_seconds",
        F.when(F.col("prev_move_time").isNotNull(),
               (F.unix_timestamp("t_put") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_move_time")))
        .otherwise(None)
    ).withColumn(
        "new_session_flag",
        F.when(
            F.col("prev_move_time").isNull() | (F.col("moves_gap_seconds") > 10800),
            1
        ).otherwise(0)
    ).withColumn(
        "session_id",
        F.sum("new_session_flag").over(
            Window.partitionBy("CHE_Id", "move_date")
                  .orderBy("t_put")
                  .rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
        )
    )
    
    # Calculate session metrics
    session_metrics = che_sessions.groupBy("CHE_Id", "move_date", "session_id").agg(
        F.min("t_put").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("t_put").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("mve_gkey").alias("moves_in_session")
    ).withColumn(
        "session_worktime_seconds",
        F.when(
            F.col("moves_in_session") == 1,
            3600  # 1 hour in seconds
        ).otherwise(
            F.unix_timestamp("session_end") - F.unix_timestamp("session_start")
        )
    ).withColumn(
        "session_worktime_hours",
        F.col("session_worktime_seconds") / 3600.0
    )
    
    # Join back and calculate per-move active time
    che_with_active_time = che_sessions.join(
        session_metrics.select("CHE_Id", "move_date", "session_id", "session_worktime_seconds"),
        on=["CHE_Id", "move_date", "session_id"],
        how="left"
    ).withColumn(
        "move_active_time_seconds",
        F.col("session_worktime_seconds") / F.count("*").over(
            Window.partitionBy("CHE_Id", "move_date", "session_id")
        )
    )
    
    # Pivot to get active time for each CHE type - more efficient than multiple joins
    active_time_pivot = che_with_active_time.groupBy("mve_gkey").pivot("che_type", ["fetch", "carry", "put"]).agg(
        F.first("move_active_time_seconds").alias("active_time_seconds"),
        F.first("session_id").alias("session_id")
    ).fillna(0)  # Fill nulls with 0
    
    # Rename pivoted columns
    for che_type in ["fetch", "carry", "put"]:
        active_time_pivot = active_time_pivot \
            .withColumnRenamed(f"{che_type}_active_time_seconds", f"{che_type}_active_time_seconds") \
            .withColumnRenamed(f"{che_type}_session_id", f"{che_type}_session_id")
    
else:
    # Create empty active time dataframe if no CHE moves
    active_time_pivot = spark.createDataFrame([], schema="mve_gkey string")
    for che_type in ["fetch", "carry", "put"]:
        active_time_pivot = active_time_pivot \
            .withColumn(f"{che_type}_active_time_seconds", F.lit(None).cast("double")) \
            .withColumn(f"{che_type}_session_id", F.lit(None).cast("long"))

# 6. JOIN ACTIVE TIME BACK TO MAIN DATAFRAME
# ===========================================

if active_time_pivot.count() > 0:
    final_output = rtg_moves_with_actual.join(
        active_time_pivot,
        on="mve_gkey",
        how="left"
    )
else:
    # If no active time data, just add empty columns
    final_output = rtg_moves_with_actual
    for che_type in ["fetch", "carry", "put"]:
        final_output = final_output \
            .withColumn(f"{che_type}_active_time_seconds", F.lit(None).cast("double")) \
            .withColumn(f"{che_type}_session_id", F.lit(None).cast("long"))

# Add calculated columns
final_output = final_output.withColumn(
    "active_time_seconds",
    F.greatest(
        F.coalesce(F.col("fetch_active_time_seconds"), F.lit(0)),
        F.coalesce(F.col("carry_active_time_seconds"), F.lit(0)),
        F.coalesce(F.col("put_active_time_seconds"), F.lit(0))
    )
).withColumn(
    "active_time_hours",
    F.col("active_time_seconds") / 3600.0
).withColumn(
    "is_productive_move",
    F.when(
        F.col("Move_Kind_Actual").isin([
            "DSCH", "LOAD", "RECV", "DLVR", "SHFT"
        ]),
        1
    ).otherwise(0)
)

# Unpersist cached dataframe
rtg_moves_with_actual.unpersist()

output_path = f"{base_path}/gold/rtg_productivity_enhanced"

# Select final columns in organized order
final_columns = [
    # Original identifiers
    "mve_gkey",
    "Unit_Nbr",
    "Facility_Id",
    "Complex_Id",
    "Yard_Id",
    "Carrier_Visit_Key",
    
    # Movement information
    "Event_Type_Id",
    "Move_Kind",
    "Move_Kind_Actual",  # NEW COLUMN
    
    # Location information
    "From_Location",
    "To_Location",
    "From_Position_Name",
    "To_Position_Name",
    
    # CHE Information
    "Fetch_CHE_Id",
    "Fetch_CHE_Kind",
    "Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id",
    "Carry_CHE_Id",
    "Carry_CHE_Kind",
    "Carry_CHE_Operator_Id",
    "Put_CHE_Id",
    "Put_CHE_Kind",
    "Put_CHE_Operator_Id",
    "QC_CHE_Id",
    "QC_CHE_Kind",
    
    # Main timing column
    "t_put",
    
    # Other timing columns
    "t_carry_complete",
    "t_fetch",
    "t_dispatch",
    "t_discharge",
    "t_carry_dispatch",
    "t_carry_fetch_ready",
    "t_carry_put_ready",
    
    # Active time columns (NEW)
    "fetch_session_id",
    "carry_session_id",
    "put_session_id",
    "fetch_active_time_seconds",
    "carry_active_time_seconds",
    "put_active_time_seconds",
    "active_time_seconds",  # NEW COLUMN - maximum of all CHE active times
    "active_time_hours",  # NEW COLUMN - in hours
    
    # Other columns
    "dist_carry",
    "dist_start",
    "Twin_Fetch",
    "Twin_Carry",
    "Twin_Put",
    "Category_Id",
    "Freight_Kind_Id",
    "to_pos_gkey",
    "fm_pos_gkey",
    "Restow_Reason",
    "Container_Line_Id",
    "Container_Line_Role",
    "pow",
    "ufv_gkey",
    "Berth_Id",
    "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg",
    "active_ufv",
    "Requires_Power_Flag",
    "OOG_Flag",
    "Shipper_Id",
    "Consignee_Id",
    "Commodity_Id",
    "ATD",
    "Rehandles",
    "ATA",
    
    # Calculated/helper columns
    "move_date",
    "is_productive_move",
    
    # Time dimensions
    "Year",
    "Month",
    "Week"
]

# Check which columns exist and filter
existing_columns = final_output.columns
final_columns_filtered = [col for col in final_columns if col in existing_columns]

# Check for missing columns
missing_columns = set(final_columns) - set(existing_columns)
if missing_columns:
    print(f"Warning: Missing columns that won't be included: {missing_columns}")

# Select only existing columns
final_output_clean = final_output.select(*final_columns_filtered)

# Add processing timestamp for tracking
final_output_clean = final_output_clean.withColumn("last_updated", F.current_timestamp())

# 7. SAVE TO GOLD LAYER
# =====================
try:
    # Check if table exists
    if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, output_path):
        print(f"Table exists at {output_path}. Performing merge/upsert...")
        
        # Load existing Delta table
        deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, output_path)
        
        # Perform merge - update existing records, insert new ones
        merge_result = deltaTable.alias("target") \
            .merge(
                final_output_clean.alias("source"),
                "target.mve_gkey = source.mve_gkey"  # Match on mve_gkey
            ) \
            .whenMatchedUpdateAll() \
            .whenNotMatchedInsertAll() \
            .execute()
        
        print("Merge/upsert completed successfully")
        
        # Get merge statistics
        history = deltaTable.history(1).collect()[0]
        if 'operationMetrics' in history:
            metrics = history['operationMetrics']
            print(f"Rows updated: {metrics.get('numTargetRowsUpdated', 0)}")
            print(f"Rows inserted: {metrics.get('numTargetRowsInserted', 0)}")
        
    else:
        # Table doesn't exist, create it for the first time
        print(f"Creating new table at {output_path}")
        
        final_output_clean.write \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .format("delta") \
            .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
            .partitionBy("Year", "Month") \
            .save(output_path)
        
        print("Initial table creation completed")
        
    # Optimize the table after write
    deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, output_path)
    deltaTable.optimize().executeCompaction()
    print("Table optimization completed")
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error during merge/write: {str(e)}")
    print("Falling back to append mode...")
    
    # Fallback to append if merge fails
    final_output_clean.write \
        .mode("append") \
        .format("delta") \
        .partitionBy("Year", "Month") \
        .save(output_path)
    
    print("Data appended successfully")

print(f"Data saved to: {output_path}")

# 8. DISPLAY SUMMARY AND VALIDATION
# ==================================
print("\n=== RTG PRODUCTIVITY SUMMARY ===\n")

# Check Move_Kind_Actual distribution
move_distribution = final_output_clean.groupBy("Move_Kind", "Move_Kind_Actual").count().orderBy("Move_Kind", "Move_Kind_Actual")
print("Move Kind vs Move_Kind_Actual Distribution:")
display(move_distribution)

# Daily productivity summary
print("\nDaily RTG Productivity Summary:")
daily_productivity = final_output_clean.groupBy("move_date").agg(
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "DSCH", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("DSCH_Moves"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "LOAD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("LOAD_Moves"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Regular_Yard"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD_DSCH", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Yard_DSCH"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD_LOAD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Yard_LOAD"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("is_productive_move") == 1, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_Productive"),
    F.countDistinct("Fetch_CHE_Id", "Carry_CHE_Id", "Put_CHE_Id").alias("RTGs_Used")
).orderBy("move_date")
display(daily_productivity.limit(20))

# Verify active time calculation
print("\nSample Data with Active Time:")
time_sample = final_output_clean.filter(
    F.col("active_time_seconds").isNotNull() & (F.col("active_time_seconds") > 0)
).select(
    "mve_gkey",
    "Unit_Nbr",
    "Move_Kind",
    "Move_Kind_Actual",
    "From_Position_Name",
    "To_Position_Name",
    "Fetch_CHE_Id",
    "Put_CHE_Id",
    "t_put",
    "fetch_active_time_seconds",
    "carry_active_time_seconds",
    "put_active_time_seconds",
    "active_time_seconds"
).limit(20)
display(time_sample)

# Summary statistics
print("\nOverall Statistics:")
stats = final_output_clean.agg(
    F.count("*").alias("Total_Moves"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "DSCH", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_DSCH"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "LOAD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_LOAD"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD_DSCH", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_YARD_DSCH"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD_LOAD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_YARD_LOAD"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Move_Kind_Actual") == "YARD", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Total_Regular_Yard"),
    F.avg("active_time_seconds").alias("Avg_Active_Time_Seconds")
).collect()[0]

print(f"""
Total RTG Moves: {stats['Total_Moves']}
DSCH Operations: {stats['Total_DSCH']}
LOAD Operations: {stats['Total_LOAD']}
YARD DSCH Operations: {stats['Total_YARD_DSCH']}
YARD LOAD Operations: {stats['Total_YARD_LOAD']}
Regular Yard Moves: {stats['Total_Regular_Yard']}
Avg Active Time per Move: {stats['Avg_Active_Time_Seconds']:.2f} seconds
""")

# 9. CREATE AGGREGATED PRODUCTIVITY TABLE
# ========================================
print("\n=== CREATING AGGREGATED PRODUCTIVITY TABLE ===\n")

# First, add CHE_Id column and Shift information
final_output_with_che = final_output_clean.withColumn(
    "CHE_Id",
    F.coalesce(
        F.when(F.col("Fetch_CHE_Kind") == "RTG", F.col("Fetch_CHE_Id")),
        F.when(F.col("Carry_CHE_Kind") == "RTG", F.col("Carry_CHE_Id")),
        F.when(F.col("Put_CHE_Kind") == "RTG", F.col("Put_CHE_Id"))
    )
).withColumn(
    "Has_Multiple_RTGs",
    F.when(
        (F.col("Fetch_CHE_Id") != F.col("Carry_CHE_Id")) |
        (F.col("Carry_CHE_Id") != F.col("Put_CHE_Id")) |
        (F.col("Fetch_CHE_Id") != F.col("Put_CHE_Id")),
        True
    ).otherwise(False)
).withColumn(
    "Hour",
    F.hour("t_put")
).withColumn(
    "Shift",
    F.when(
        (F.col("Hour") >= 7) & (F.col("Hour") < 19),
        "Day"
    ).otherwise("Night")
).withColumn(
    "Shift_Date",
    F.when(
        (F.col("Shift") == "Night") & (F.col("Hour") < 7),
        F.date_sub(F.col("move_date"), 1)
    ).otherwise(F.col("move_date"))
)

# Filter out rows where CHE_Id is null
final_with_che_filtered = final_output_with_che.filter(F.col("CHE_Id").isNotNull())

# Step 1: Calculate Shift-level metrics (CHE + Date + Shift)
shift_level_metrics = final_with_che_filtered.groupBy(
    "CHE_Id", 
    "Shift_Date",
    "Shift"
).agg(
    F.round(F.sum("active_time_hours"), 2).alias("Active_Hours"),
    F.min("t_put").alias("Shift_Start_Time"),
    F.max("t_put").alias("Shift_End_Time"),
    F.count("mve_gkey").alias("Total_Shift_Moves")
).withColumn(
    "Shift_Duration_Hours",
    F.round(
        (F.unix_timestamp("Shift_End_Time") - F.unix_timestamp("Shift_Start_Time")) / 3600,
        2
    )
).withColumn(
    "Shift_Duration_Hours",
    F.when(F.col("Shift_Duration_Hours") <= 0, F.col("Active_Hours"))
     .otherwise(F.col("Shift_Duration_Hours"))
).withColumn(
    "Utilization_Rate",
    F.when(F.col("Shift_Duration_Hours") > 0,
           F.round((F.col("Active_Hours") / F.col("Shift_Duration_Hours")) * 100, 1)
    ).otherwise(None)
)

# Step 2: Aggregate by CHE + Date + Shift + Move_Kind_Actual (for move counts)
move_kind_metrics = final_with_che_filtered.groupBy(
    "CHE_Id", 
    "Shift_Date",
    "Shift",
    "Move_Kind_Actual"
).agg(
    F.count("mve_gkey").alias("Move_Count"),
    F.sum("is_productive_move").alias("Productive_Move_Count"),
    F.countDistinct("Unit_Nbr").alias("Unique_Containers"),
    F.sum(F.when(F.col("Has_Multiple_RTGs") == True, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("Multi_RTG_Moves")
)

# Step 3: Join shift-level metrics to move_kind-level metrics
aggregated_final = move_kind_metrics.join(
    shift_level_metrics,
    on=["CHE_Id", "Shift_Date", "Shift"],
    how="left"
).withColumn(
    # Moves per hour for this move type (using shift active hours)
    "Moves_Per_Hour",
    F.when(F.col("Active_Hours") > 0,
           F.round(F.col("Move_Count") / F.col("Active_Hours"), 1)
    ).otherwise(None)
).withColumn(
    # Percentage of shift moves for this move type
    "Percent_of_Shift_Moves",
    F.when(F.col("Total_Shift_Moves") > 0,
           F.round((F.col("Move_Count") / F.col("Total_Shift_Moves")) * 100, 1)
    ).otherwise(None)
).withColumn(
    "last_updated", 
    F.current_timestamp()
).withColumn(
    "Year", F.year("Shift_Date")
).withColumn(
    "Month", F.month("Shift_Date")
).withColumn(
    "Week", F.weekofyear("Shift_Date")
).withColumn(
    "DayOfWeek", F.dayofweek("Shift_Date")
)

# Rename Shift_Date to move_date
aggregated_final = aggregated_final.withColumnRenamed("Shift_Date", "move_date")

# Sort the data
aggregated_final = aggregated_final.orderBy("move_date", "Shift", "CHE_Id", "Move_Kind_Actual")

# # Display sample
# print("Sample of aggregated data:")
# display(aggregated_final.limit(20))


#

# 10. SAVE AGGREGATED TABLE TO GOLD LAYER
# ========================================
agg_output_path = f"{base_path}/gold/rtg_productivity_summary"

try:
    if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, agg_output_path):
        print(f"Aggregated table exists at {agg_output_path}. Performing merge...")
        
        deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, agg_output_path)
        
        # Merge on CHE_Id + move_date + Shift + Move_Kind_Actual
        deltaTable.alias("target") \
            .merge(
                aggregated_final.alias("source"),
                """
                target.CHE_Id = source.CHE_Id AND 
                target.move_date = source.move_date AND 
                target.Shift = source.Shift AND
                target.Move_Kind_Actual = source.Move_Kind_Actual
                """
            ) \
            .whenMatchedUpdateAll() \
            .whenNotMatchedInsertAll() \
            .execute()
        
        print("Merge completed")
        
    else:
        print(f"Creating new table at {agg_output_path}")
        
        aggregated_final.write \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .format("delta") \
            .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
            .partitionBy("Year", "Month") \
            .save(agg_output_path)
        
        print("Table created")
    
    # Optimize
    deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, agg_output_path)
    deltaTable.optimize().executeCompaction()
    print("Table optimized")
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {str(e)}")
    aggregated_final.write \
        .mode("overwrite") \
        .format("delta") \
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
        .partitionBy("Year", "Month") \
        .save(agg_output_path)

print(f"\nData saved to: {agg_output_path}")

from datetime import datetime

storage_account = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
file_systems    = ["malta", "mict", "gpa"]

print(f"🔧 Daily Maintenance — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
print("=" * 60)

for file_system in file_systems:
    silver_path = f"abfss://workinstruction@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/{file_system}/"

# ## DeltaToCSVExport — Multi-Source with Dynamic Date Filter

# ============================================================
# Cell 1 — Configuration
# ============================================================

from datetime import datetime, date
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta

# ── Storage Settings ──────────────────────────────────────────
storage_account = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
container       = "mundra-ct02"

base_path = f"abfss://{container}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net"

# ── Date Filter ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Options: 3 or 6  (months lookback from today)
LOOKBACK_MONTHS = 6

# ── Delta Sources to Export ───────────────────────────────────
# Add as many sources as needed.
# "source"      → path under silver/  (e.g. "moves", "vessels", "bookings")
# "date_col"    → column used for date filtering (Year + Month, or a timestamp col)
# "filter_type" → "year_month"  : filters on separate Year & Month int columns
#                 "date"        : filters on a single date/timestamp column
DELTA_SOURCES = [
    {
        "source"      : "moves",
        "date_col"    : None,          # uses Year + month columns (year_month mode)
        "filter_type" : "year_month",
        "apply_filter" : False,
    },
    {
        "source"      : "ecevents",
        "date_col"    : None, # single date/timestamp column
        "filter_type" : "year_month",
        "apply_filter" : False,
    },
    # {
    #     "source"      : "deckings",
    #     "date_col"    : None,
    #     "filter_type" : "year_month",
    # },
    # ➕ Add more sources here ...
]

# ============================================================
# Cell 2 — Compute Dynamic Date Cutoff
# ============================================================

today          = date.today()
cutoff_date    = today - relativedelta(months=LOOKBACK_MONTHS)
run_date_str   = today.strftime("%Y%m%d")          # e.g. 20260528
cutoff_year    = cutoff_date.year
cutoff_month   = cutoff_date.month

print(f"▶ Run date      : {today}")
print(f"▶ Lookback      : {LOOKBACK_MONTHS} months")
print(f"▶ Cutoff        : {cutoff_date}  (year={cutoff_year}, month={cutoff_month})")
print(f"▶ Output tag    : {run_date_str}")

# ============================================================
# Cell 3 — Export Loop
# ============================================================

from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

summary = []   # collect results for the final report

for cfg in DELTA_SOURCES:
    src         = cfg["source"]                           # e.g. "moves"
    filter_type = cfg["filter_type"]
    date_col    = cfg.get("date_col")

    delta_path   = f"{base_path}/silver/{src}"
    staging_path = f"{base_path}/export/{src}_staging/"
    output_file  = f"{container}_{src}_{run_date_str}.csv"
    final_path   = f"{base_path}/export/{src}_result/"
    dest         = f"{final_path}{output_file}"

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  Processing : silver/{src}")
    print(f"  Output     : {output_file}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    try:
        # ── Read Delta ────────────────────────────────────────
        df = spark.read.format("delta").load(delta_path)

        # ── Apply Dynamic Date Filter ─────────────────────────
        apply_filter = cfg.get("apply_filter", True)  # Default to True if not specified
        if not apply_filter:
            # Skip filtering for this source
            df_filtered = df
            print(f"  ℹ️ Filtering disabled for {src} - exporting all data")
        elif filter_type == "year_month":
            # Expects integer columns: Year, month (same as original notebook)
            df_filtered = df.filter(
                (F.col("Year") > cutoff_year) |
                (
                    (F.col("Year") == cutoff_year) &
                    (F.col("month") >= cutoff_month)
                )
            )

        elif filter_type == "date":
            # Expects a single date / timestamp column
            df_filtered = df.filter(
                F.col(date_col) >= F.lit(cutoff_date.isoformat())
            )

        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown filter_type '{filter_type}' for source '{src}'")

        record_count = df_filtered.count()
        print(f"  Records    : {record_count:,}")
        df_filtered.printSchema()

        # ── Write CSV to Staging ──────────────────────────────
        df_filtered.coalesce(1).write \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .option("header", "true") \
            .csv(staging_path)

        # ── Rename Part File → Clean CSV Name ─────────────────
        files     = mssparkutils.fs.ls(staging_path)
        part_file = [
            f.path for f in files
            if f.name.startswith("part-") and f.name.endswith(".csv")
        ][0]

        mssparkutils.fs.cp(part_file, dest, recurse=False)
        mssparkutils.fs.rm(staging_path, recurse=True)

        print(f"  ✅ Saved to : {dest}")
        summary.append({"source": src, "records": record_count, "output": output_file, "status": "✅ Success"})

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ❌ FAILED   : {e}")
        summary.append({"source": src, "records": "—", "output": output_file, "status": f"❌ {e}"})

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# ============================================================
# 1. READ FROM DELTA
# ============================================================
STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER        = "malta"                          # ← Update for MFT
DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
OUTPUT_PATH      = "gold/tranship_pairs"


BASE_PATH    = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH   = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"


df = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH)

# ============================================================
# 2. FILTER TRANSHIPMENT ONLY
# ============================================================
df_trshp = df.filter(
    (F.col("Category_Id") == "TRSHP") &
    (F.col("Event_Type_Id").isin("UNIT_DISCH", "UNIT_LOAD")) &
    (F.col("Year") >= 2026)
)

# ============================================================
# 3. EXTRACT YARDBLOCK FROM POSITION NAME
# Format: Y-MFT-XE 040 06B → XE
# ============================================================
def extract_yardblock(col_name):
    return F.when(
        F.col(col_name).startswith("Y-"),
        F.regexp_extract(F.col(col_name), r"^Y-[^-]+-([^ ]+)", 1)
    ).otherwise(F.lit(None))

df_trshp = df_trshp \
    .withColumn("From_YardBlock", extract_yardblock("From_Position_Name")) \
    .withColumn("To_YardBlock",   extract_yardblock("To_Position_Name"))

# ============================================================
# 4. CRANE LOOKUP
# ============================================================
cranes_data = [
    ("PQC34","T1"),("PQC33","T1"),("PQC32","T1"),("PQC31","T1"),
    ("PQC30","T1"),("PQC29","T2"),("PQC28","T2"),("QC07", "T2"),
    ("QC08", "T2"),("QC02", "T1"),("QC01", "T1"),("QC23", "T1"),
    ("QC20", "T1"),("QC33", "T1"),("QC34", "T1"),("QC30", "T1"),
    ("QC31", "T1"),("QC32", "T1"),("PQC27","T2"),("PQC26","T2"),
    ("PQC25","T2"),("PQC23","T1"),("PQC21","T1"),("PQC20","T1"),
    ("PQC08","T2"),("PQC07","T2"),("PQC06","T2"),("PQC05","T2"),
    ("PQC04","T2"),("PQC03","T2"),("PQC02","T1"),("PQC01","T1"),
    ("QR01", "T1"),("QC25", "T2"),("QC26", "T2"),("QC29", "T2"),
    ("QC27", "T2"),("QC28", "T2"),("QC03", "T2"),("QC04", "T2"),
    ("QC05", "T2"),("QC06", "T2")
]
df_cranes = spark.createDataFrame(cranes_data, ["CraneId", "Crane_Terminal"])

# ============================================================
# 5. YARDBLOCK LOOKUP
# ============================================================
yardblocks_data = [
    ("1A","T1"),("1B","T1"),("1C","T1"),("1D","T1"),("1E","T1"),
    ("1F","T1"),("1G","T1"),("1H","T1"),("1J","T1"),("1Q","T2"),
    ("1R","T1"),("1S","T2"),("1T","T2"),("1V","T2"),("1Y","T2"),
    ("1Z","T2"),("2A","T1"),("2B","T1"),("2C","T1"),("2D","T1"),
    ("2E","T1"),("2F","T1"),("2G","T1"),("2H","T1"),("2J","T1"),
    ("2L","T2"),("2R","T1"),("2S","T2"),("2N","T1"),("3A","T1"),
    ("3B","T1"),("3C","T1"),("3D","T1"),("3E","T1"),("3F","T1"),
    ("3L","T2"),("3M","T2"),("3N","T1"),("3P","T2"),("3Q","T2"),
    ("3R","T1"),("3S","T2"),("3T","T2"),("3V","T2"),("3Y","T2"),
    ("3Z","T2"),("4A","T1"),("4B","T1"),("4C","T1"),("4N","T2"),
    ("5N","T2"),("CZ","T2"),("GD","T1"),("GE","T1"),("GF","T1"),
    ("KD","T2"),("SC","T1"),("WA","T1"),("WB","T1"),("WC","T2"),
    ("WE","T2"),("XA","T1"),("XB","T1"),("XC","T1"),("XD","T1"),
    ("XE","T1"),("XF","T1"),("XG","T1"),("XH","T1"),("XJ","T1"),
    ("XK","T1"),("XL","T1"),("XM","T1"),("XR","T1"),("PA","T1"),
    ("1N","T1"),("ONS","T1"),("BR","T1")
]
df_yardblocks = spark.createDataFrame(yardblocks_data, ["YardBlock", "TerminalShort"])
# ============================================================
# 6. JOIN TERMINAL LOOKUPS
# ============================================================
df_enriched = df_trshp \
    .join(df_cranes,    df_trshp.pow            == df_cranes.CraneId,      "left") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yf"), 
          df_trshp.From_YardBlock == F.col("yf.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "From_Terminal") \
    .join(df_yardblocks.alias("yt"), 
          df_trshp.To_YardBlock   == F.col("yt.YardBlock"), "left") \
    .withColumnRenamed("TerminalShort", "To_Terminal")

# ============================================================
# 7. SEQUENCE MOVES PER UNIT
# ============================================================
window_seq = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_sequenced = df_enriched.withColumn("move_seq", F.row_number().over(window_seq))

# ============================================================
# 8. SPLIT INTO DISCH AND LOAD
# ============================================================
df_disch = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_DISCH") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey", "move_seq",
        "t_put", "Carrier_Visit_Key",
        "Crane_Terminal", "To_Terminal", "To_YardBlock",
        "Freight_Kind_Id", "pow"
    )

df_load = df_sequenced.filter(F.col("Event_Type_Id") == "UNIT_LOAD") \
    .select(
        "Unit_Nbr",
        F.col("mve_gkey").alias("load_mve_gkey"),
        F.col("move_seq").alias("load_move_seq"),
        F.col("t_put").alias("load_datetime"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_vessel"),
        F.col("Crane_Terminal").alias("load_crane_terminal"),
        F.col("From_Terminal").alias("load_yard_terminal"),
        F.col("From_YardBlock").alias("load_yard_block"),
        F.col("pow").alias("load_pow"),
        F.col("Carrier_Visit_Key").alias("load_Carrier_Visit_Key")
    )

# ============================================================
# 9. PAIR DISCH → NEXT LOAD
# LEFT JOIN to keep discharged units with no load yet (Pending)
# ============================================================
window_unit = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("move_seq")

# LEFT JOIN — keeps DISCH rows even with no matching LOAD
df_joined = df_disch.join(df_load, on="Unit_Nbr", how="left") \
    .filter(
        F.col("load_move_seq").isNull() |           # ← Pending Load (no load yet)
        (F.col("load_move_seq") > F.col("move_seq")) # ← Valid next load
    )

# Keep only the CLOSEST next load per discharge (Pending rows have no load so rank = 1)
window_closest = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr", "mve_gkey").orderBy(
    F.col("load_move_seq").asc_nulls_last()         # ← NULLs (Pending) go last in sort
)

df_paired = df_joined \
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(window_closest)) \
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1) \
    .drop("rn", "load_move_seq", "move_seq")

# ============================================================
# 10. ADD DERIVED COLUMNS
# ============================================================
window_tranship = Window.partitionBy("Unit_Nbr").orderBy("t_put")

df_final = df_paired \
    .withColumn("dwell_hours",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_datetime").isNotNull(),
            # Completed transhipment — actual dwell
            (F.col("load_datetime").cast("long") -
             F.col("t_put").cast("long")) / 3600
        ).otherwise(
            # Pending load — dwell so far since discharge
            (F.unix_timestamp(F.current_timestamp()) -
             F.col("t_put").cast("long")) / 3600
        )
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_sequence",
        F.row_number().over(window_tranship)
    ) \
    .withColumn("tranship_type",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_mve_gkey").isNull(),
            F.lit("Pending Load")                           # No load yet
        ).when(
            (F.col("Crane_Terminal") == F.col("To_Terminal")) &
            (F.col("To_Terminal")  == F.col("load_yard_terminal"))  &
            (F.col("load_yard_terminal")   == F.col("load_crane_terminal")),
            F.lit("Same-Terminal")                          # All 4 legs on same terminal
        ).otherwise(
            F.lit("Cross-Terminal")                         # Any leg differs
        )
    
    ) \
    .withColumn("terminal_flow",
        F.when(
            F.col("load_mve_gkey").isNull(),
            F.concat(F.col("Crane_Terminal"), F.lit(" → Pending"))
        ).otherwise(
            F.concat(F.col("Crane_Terminal"), F.lit(" → "), F.col("load_crane_terminal"))
        )
    ) \
    .withColumn("disch_date",       F.to_date("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("load_date",        F.to_date("load_datetime")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year",       F.year("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month",      F.month("t_put")) \
    .withColumn("disch_month_name", F.date_format("t_put", "MMMM")) \
    .withColumn("disch_year_month", F.date_format("t_put", "yyyy-MM")) \
    .withColumnRenamed("t_put",             "disch_datetime") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Carrier_Visit_Key", "disch_vessel") \
    .withColumnRenamed("Crane_Terminal",    "disch_crane_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_Terminal",       "disch_yard_terminal") \
    .withColumnRenamed("To_YardBlock",      "disch_yard_block")

# ============================================================
# 11. WRITE TO DELTA (silver layer)
# ============================================================
df_final.cache()

# Sanity check before writing
print(f"Total pairs:        {df_final.count()}")
print(f"Same-Terminal:      {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Same-Terminal').count()}")
print(f"Cross-Terminal:     {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Cross-Terminal').count()}")
print(f"Pending Load:       {df_final.filter(F.col('tranship_type') == 'Pending Load').count()}")

df_final.write \
    .format("delta") \
    .mode("overwrite") \
    .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

print("✅ tranship_pairs written successfully!")

df_final.unpersist()
