# ============================================================
# CELL 1 — Configuration
# ============================================================

STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER        = "cwit"
DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
OUTPUT_PATH      = "gold/rehandles_report_new"
WEIGHT_TOLERANCE = 2000        # kg
THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 10800      # 3 hours — change to 7200 for 2 hours

BASE_PATH    = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH   = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"

# ============================================================
# CELL 2 — Terminal Configuration
# ============================================================
# Set TERMINAL_FORMAT to match your terminal:
#   "CWIT"     → Y-CWIT-1A003C.5
#   "CGSA"     → Y-CGSA-3A 29 A 2
#   "STANDARD" → Y-CTB-2B02E.3

TERMINAL_FORMAT = "CWIT"   # ← Change this only

TERMINAL_POSITION_EXAMPLES = {
    "CWIT"     : "Y-CWIT-1A003C.5   → Block=1A, Bay=003, Row=C, Tier=5",
    "CGSA"     : "Y-CGSA-3A 29 A 2  → Block=3A, Bay=29,  Row=A, Tier=2",
    "STANDARD" : "Y-CTB-2B02E.3     → Block=2B, Bay=02,  Row=E, Tier=3",
}

print(f"✅ Terminal Format : {TERMINAL_FORMAT}")
print(f"   Position Format : {TERMINAL_POSITION_EXAMPLES[TERMINAL_FORMAT]}")

# Run this to see exact Move_Kind values in your data
df_moves.select("Move_Kind").distinct().orderBy("Move_Kind").show(50, truncate=False)

# How many shifts have valid parsed positions?
df_moves.filter(F.col("is_shift") == True) \
    .select(
        "From_Position_Name",
        "block", "bay", "row", "tier"
    ).show(20, truncate=False)

# Check Move_Kind distribution where tier is null
df_moves.filter(
    F.col("is_shift") == True
).select(
    "From_Position_Name", "block", "bay", "row", "tier", "Move_Kind"
).groupBy("Move_Kind", "tier") \
 .agg(F.count("*").alias("count"),
      F.first("From_Position_Name").alias("sample_position")) \
 .orderBy("Move_Kind", "tier") \
 .show(50, truncate=False)

# All distinct From_Position_Name where YARD move has null tier + move count
df_moves.filter(
    (F.col("Move_Kind") == "YARD") &
    (F.col("tier").isNull())
) \
.groupBy("From_Position_Name") \
.agg(F.count("*").alias("move_count")) \
.orderBy(F.desc("move_count")) \
.show(100, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 3 — Imports & Classifiers
# ============================================================

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from collections import defaultdict
import re

# Exact Move_Kind values from the Delta table
TARGET_MOVES = {'LOAD'}

SHIFT_MOVES  = {'SHFT', 'YARD'}

def is_target_move(mk):
    if not mk: return False
    return str(mk).strip().upper() in TARGET_MOVES

def is_shift_move(mk):
    if not mk: return False
    return str(mk).strip().upper() in SHIFT_MOVES

is_target_udf = F.udf(is_target_move, BooleanType())
is_shift_udf  = F.udf(is_shift_move,  BooleanType())

# ── Verify ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("=== Classifier Test ===")
for mk in ['LOAD', 'SHFT', 'YARD', 'SHOB', 'DSCH', 'DLVR', 'RECV', 'OTHR']:
    print(f"  {mk:8s} → is_shift={is_shift_move(mk)}, is_load={is_target_move(mk)}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 4 — Load Delta Table
# ============================================================

df_moves = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH)

df_moves = df_moves.filter(F.col("t_put").isNotNull())

print(f"✅ Records loaded: {df_moves.count():,}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 6 — Rehandle Matching
# ============================================================

shifts_list = df_moves.filter(F.col("is_shift") == True) \
    .select(
        "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "Carrier_Visit_Key", "Time_Completed",
        "full_stack", "block", "bay", "row", "tier", "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"
    ).orderBy("Time_Completed").collect()

loads_list = df_moves.filter(F.col("is_load") == True) \
    .select(
        "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "Carrier_Visit_Key", "Time_Completed",
        "full_stack", "block", "bay", "row", "tier", "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"
    ).orderBy("Time_Completed").collect()

print(f"✅ Shifts : {len(shifts_list):,}")
print(f"✅ Loads  : {len(loads_list):,}")

# ─── Index Loads by Block+Row ─────────────────────────────────
load_by_stack_row = defaultdict(list)
for r in loads_list:
    if r["full_stack"]:
        load_by_stack_row[r["full_stack"]].append(r)

# ─── Matching Loop ────────────────────────────────────────────
results            = []
total_housekeeping = 0

for shift in shifts_list:
    if not shift["full_stack"]:          # ← Only need valid stack now
        total_housekeeping += 1
        continue

    stack_key  = shift["full_stack"]     # ← Match on full_stack directly
    shift_time = shift["Time_Completed"]
    target_load = None

    for load in load_by_stack_row.get(stack_key, []):
        if load["Time_Completed"] <= shift_time:                                        continue  # Load after shift
        if (load["Time_Completed"] - shift_time).total_seconds() > THRESHOLD_SECONDS:  continue  # Within threshold
        target_load = load
        break

    if target_load is None:
        total_housekeeping += 1
        continue



    # ─── Categorize ──────────────────────────────────────────
    shift_tier = shift["tier"]
    ca = shift["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
    cb = target_load["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
    wa = shift["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]
    wb = target_load["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]

    weight_diff   = abs(wa - wb) if (wa is not None and wb is not None) else None
    same_outbound = (ca is not None and cb is not None and ca == cb)
    same_weight   = (weight_diff is not None and weight_diff <= WEIGHT_TOLERANCE)

    if same_outbound and same_weight:
        category = "Unnecessary Shifting (All Same)"
    elif same_outbound:
        category = "Same Outbound, Different Weight"
    else:
        category = "Different Outbound"

    results.append({
        # ── Join Keys ────────────────────────────────────────
        "mve_gkey_shift"    : shift["mve_gkey"],
        "mve_gkey_load"     : target_load["mve_gkey"],
        "carrier_visit_key" : int(cb) if cb else None,
        "unit_nbr_shift"    : shift["Unit_Nbr"],
        "unit_nbr_load"     : target_load["Unit_Nbr"],
        # ── Shift Info ───────────────────────────────────────
        "stack"             : shift["full_stack"],
        "shift_time"        : shift_time,
        "shift_date"        : shift_time.date() if shift_time else None,
        "shift_week"        : shift_time.strftime('%G-W%V') if shift_time else None,
        "a_tier"            : shift_tier,
        "a_carrier_visit_key": int(ca) if ca else None,
        "a_weight_kg"       : wa,
        # ── Load Info ────────────────────────────────────────
        "b_tier"            : target_load["tier"],
        "b_carrier_visit_key": int(cb) if cb else None,
        "b_weight_kg"       : wb,
        # ── Classification ───────────────────────────────────
        "category"          : category,
        "weight_diff_kg"    : weight_diff,
        "time_diff_seconds" : int((target_load["Time_Completed"] - shift_time).total_seconds()),
    })

print(f"✅ Rehandle matches : {len(results):,}")
print(f"✅ Housekeeping     : {total_housekeeping:,}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 7 — Write to Gold Delta Table (Overwrite)
# ============================================================

from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql.types import *

schema = StructType([
    StructField("mve_gkey_shift",      IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("mve_gkey_load",       IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("carrier_visit_key",   IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("unit_nbr_shift",      StringType(),   True),
    StructField("unit_nbr_load",       StringType(),   True),
    StructField("stack",               StringType(),   True),
    StructField("shift_time",          TimestampType(),True),
    StructField("shift_date",          DateType(),     True),
    StructField("shift_week",          StringType(),   True),
    StructField("a_tier",              IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("a_carrier_visit_key", IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("a_weight_kg",         DoubleType(),   True),
    StructField("b_tier",              IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("b_carrier_visit_key", IntegerType(),  True),
    StructField("b_weight_kg",         DoubleType(),   True),
    StructField("category",            StringType(),   True),
    StructField("weight_diff_kg",      DoubleType(),   True),
    StructField("time_diff_seconds",   IntegerType(),  True),
])

# ─── Convert Python list → Spark DataFrame ───────────────────
df_results = spark.createDataFrame(results, schema=schema)

try:
    if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, OUTPUT_DELTA):
        print(f"✅ Gold table exists — overwriting")

        df_results.write \
            .format("delta") \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
            .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

        print(f"✅ Gold table overwritten at: {OUTPUT_DELTA}")

    else:
        print(f"📦 Gold table does not exist — creating new table")

        df_results.write \
            .format("delta") \
            .mode("overwrite") \
            .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
            .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

        print(f"✅ Gold table created at: {OUTPUT_DELTA}")

    print(f"📊 Records written: {df_results.count():,}")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"❌ Failed to write to Gold: {str(e)}")
    raise

# ============================================================
# CELL 8 — Register Table & Verify
# ============================================================

spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db")

spark.sql(f"""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db.rehandle_details
    USING DELTA LOCATION '{OUTPUT_DELTA}'
""")

print("✅ Registered → rehandles_db.rehandle_details")

# ─── Verify ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(OUTPUT_DELTA)
print(f"\n📋 rehandle_details: {df_check.count():,} rows × {len(df_check.columns)} cols")
df_check.show(5, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 1 — Configuration
# ============================================================

STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
CONTAINER        = "malta"                          # ← Update for MFT
DELTA_MOVES_PATH = "silver/moves"
OUTPUT_PATH      = "gold/rehandles_report_mft"

THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 7200      # 2 hours window for matching

BASE_PATH    = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net"
MOVES_PATH   = f"{BASE_PATH}/{DELTA_MOVES_PATH}"
OUTPUT_DELTA = f"{BASE_PATH}/{OUTPUT_PATH}"

print(f"✅ Moves Source : {MOVES_PATH}")
print(f"✅ Output Target: {OUTPUT_DELTA}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 2 — Terminal Configuration
# ============================================================

TERMINAL_FORMAT = "MFT"

# Position format breakdown:
# Y-MFT-1Z 025 03B
# ├─────┘ │   │ │└─ Tier (alphabetic: A=1, B=2, C=3...)
# │       │   │ └── Row (numeric: 01, 02, 03...)
# │       │   └──── Bay (numeric: 025)
# │       └──────── Section (alphanumeric: 1Z, 2A, etc.)
# └──────────────── Prefix

# print(f"✅ Terminal Format: {TERMINAL_FORMAT}")
# print(f"   Position Example: Y-MFT-1Z 025 03B")
# print(f"   → Section=1Z, Bay=025, Row=03, Tier=B (tier 2)")

# ============================================================
# CELL 3 — Imports & Helper Functions
# ============================================================

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from collections import defaultdict
import re

# ─── Move Classification (Using Event_Type_Id) ───────────────
TARGET_MOVES = {'UNIT_LOAD'}
SHIFT_MOVES  = {'UNIT_YARD_SHIFT', 'UNIT_YARD_MOVE'}

def is_target_move(event_type):
    if not event_type: return False
    return str(event_type).strip().upper() in TARGET_MOVES

def is_shift_move(event_type):
    if not event_type: return False
    return str(event_type).strip().upper() in SHIFT_MOVES

is_target_udf = F.udf(is_target_move, BooleanType())
is_shift_udf  = F.udf(is_shift_move,  BooleanType())

# ─── Tier Conversion (Alphabetic → Numeric) ──────────────────
def tier_letter_to_number(letter):
    """Convert tier letter to number: A=1, B=2, C=3, etc."""
    if not letter or not isinstance(letter, str):
        return None
    letter = letter.upper()
    if len(letter) == 1 and 'A' <= letter <= 'Z':
        return ord(letter) - ord('A') + 1
    return None

# ─── Verify Classifiers ──────────────────────────────────────
print("=== Classifier Test ===")
for evt in ['UNIT_LOAD', 'UNIT_YARD_SHIFT', 'UNIT_YARD_MOVE']:
    print(f"  {evt:20s} → is_shift={is_shift_move(evt)}, is_load={is_target_move(evt)}")

print("\n=== Tier Conversion Test ===")
for t in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']:
    print(f"  {t} → {tier_letter_to_number(t)}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 4 — Load Delta Table (Filtered)
# ============================================================

RELEVANT_EVENTS = ['UNIT_LOAD', 'UNIT_YARD_SHIFT', 'UNIT_YARD_MOVE']

df_moves = spark.read.format("delta").load(MOVES_PATH) \
    .filter(
        (F.col("t_put").isNotNull()) &
        (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("Event_Type_Id"))).isin(RELEVANT_EVENTS))
    )

print(f"✅ Records loaded (UNIT_LOAD/UNIT_YARD_SHIFT/UNIT_YARD_MOVE only): {df_moves.count():,}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 5 — Position Parsing for MFT Format
# ============================================================

def parse_mft_position(pos):
    """
    Parse MFT position format: Y-MFT-{Section} {Bay} {Row}{Tier}
    Example: Y-MFT-1Z 025 03B
    
    Returns: (stack, section, bay, row, tier_letter, tier_numeric)
    - stack: Section-Bay-Row (for matching, excludes tier)
    - section: Block/area code (e.g., 1Z, 2A)
    - bay: Bay number (e.g., 025)
    - row: Row number (e.g., 03)
    - tier_letter: Original tier letter (e.g., B)
    - tier_numeric: Numeric tier (A=1, B=2, etc.)
    """
    if not pos:
        return (None, None, None, None, None, None)
    
    pos = str(pos).strip()
    
    # Pattern: Y-MFT-{Section} {Bay} {Row}{Tier}
    # Section: 1-2 alphanumeric chars
    # Bay: 2-3 digit number
    # Row: 2 digit number
    # Tier: Single letter A-Z
    pattern = r'^Y-MFT-([A-Z0-9]{1,2})\s+(\d{2,3})\s+(\d{2})([A-Z])$'
    
    match = re.match(pattern, pos, re.IGNORECASE)
    
    if match:
        section, bay, row, tier_letter = match.groups()
        section = section.upper()
        tier_letter = tier_letter.upper()
        tier_numeric = tier_letter_to_number(tier_letter)
        
        # Stack = Section-Bay-Row (unique ground position, excludes tier)
        stack = f"{section}-{bay}-{row}"
        
        return (stack, section, bay, row, tier_letter, tier_numeric)
    
    return (None, None, None, None, None, None)


# Define schema for parsed position
parse_pos_schema = StructType([
    StructField("stack",        StringType()),   # Section-Bay-Row
    StructField("section",      StringType()),   # Block/area (1Z, 2A)
    StructField("bay",          StringType()),   # Bay number
    StructField("row",          StringType()),   # Row number
    StructField("tier_letter",  StringType()),   # Original tier (A, B, C)
    StructField("tier",         IntegerType()),  # Numeric tier (1, 2, 3)
])

parse_pos_udf = F.udf(parse_mft_position, parse_pos_schema)

# ─── Test Parser ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# print("=== Position Parser Test ===")
# test_positions = ['Y-MFT-1Z 025 03B', 'Y-MFT-2A 001 01A', 'Y-MFT-1Z 025 03D']
# for pos in test_positions:
#     result = parse_mft_position(pos)
#     print(f"  {pos:25s} → stack={result[0]}, section={result[1]}, tier={result[5]}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 6 — Apply Parsing to Both From and To Positions
# ============================================================

# Parse FROM position (where container was picked up)
df_moves = df_moves \
    .withColumn("_from_pos",        parse_pos_udf(F.col("From_Position_Name"))) \
    .withColumn("from_stack",       F.col("_from_pos.stack")) \
    .withColumn("from_section",     F.col("_from_pos.section")) \
    .withColumn("from_bay",         F.col("_from_pos.bay")) \
    .withColumn("from_row",         F.col("_from_pos.row")) \
    .withColumn("from_tier_letter", F.col("_from_pos.tier_letter")) \
    .withColumn("from_tier",        F.col("_from_pos.tier")) \
    .drop("_from_pos")

# Parse TO position (where container was placed)
df_moves = df_moves \
    .withColumn("_to_pos",          parse_pos_udf(F.col("To_Position_Name"))) \
    .withColumn("to_stack",         F.col("_to_pos.stack")) \
    .withColumn("to_section",       F.col("_to_pos.section")) \
    .withColumn("to_bay",           F.col("_to_pos.bay")) \
    .withColumn("to_row",           F.col("_to_pos.row")) \
    .withColumn("to_tier_letter",   F.col("_to_pos.tier_letter")) \
    .withColumn("to_tier",          F.col("_to_pos.tier")) \
    .drop("_to_pos")

# Add move classification using Event_Type_Id
df_moves = df_moves \
    .withColumn("is_load",          is_target_udf(F.col("Event_Type_Id"))) \
    .withColumn("is_shift",         is_shift_udf(F.col("Event_Type_Id"))) \
    .withColumn("Time_Completed",   F.col("t_put"))

print(f"✅ Positions parsed for MFT format")
df_moves.select(
    "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "Event_Type_Id",
    "From_Position_Name", "from_stack", "from_section", "from_tier",
    "To_Position_Name", "to_section","Freight_Kind_Id"
).show(10, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 6 — Rehandle Matching (Full Output: LOADs + Pairs + Housekeeping)
# ============================================================

from collections import defaultdict

# ─── Step 1: Collect shifts and loads into memory ────────────
shifts_list = df_moves.filter(F.col("is_shift") == True) \
    .select(
        "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "Carrier_Visit_Key", "Time_Completed",
        "from_stack", "from_section", "from_tier", "from_tier_letter",
        "to_section", "To_Position_Name",
        "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg", "Event_Type_Id", "Freight_Kind_Id", "Category_Id", "pow"
    ).orderBy("Time_Completed").collect()

loads_list = df_moves.filter(F.col("is_load") == True) \
    .select(
        "mve_gkey", "Unit_Nbr", "Carrier_Visit_Key", "Time_Completed",
        "from_stack", "from_section", "from_tier", "from_tier_letter",
        "From_Position_Name", "Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg", "Freight_Kind_Id", "Category_Id", "pow"
    ).orderBy("Time_Completed").collect()

print(f"✅ Shifts : {len(shifts_list):,}")
print(f"✅ Loads  : {len(loads_list):,}")

# ─── Step 2: Index loads by from_stack ───────────────────────
load_by_stack = defaultdict(list)
for load in loads_list:
    if load["from_stack"]:
        load_by_stack[load["from_stack"]].append(load)

# ─── Step 3: Classify every shift ────────────────────────────
# A shift is a Rehandle if:
#   1. Same from_stack as a subsequent load
#   2. Load is within THRESHOLD_SECONDS after the shift
#   3. Shift tier > Load tier (shift was on top of the loaded container)
#   4. Shift stayed in the same section (to_section == from_section)
#
# A shift is HouseKeeping_01 if conditions 1+2+3 are met BUT
#   the shift moved to a different section (to_section != from_section)
#
# Everything else is HouseKeeping

rehandle_pairs     = []  # LOAD rows with shift info populated
matched_load_keys  = set()  # load mve_gkeys consumed in a rehandle pair
matched_shift_keys = set()  # shift mve_gkeys classified (any category)
shift_categories   = {}     # mve_gkey → category for all classified shifts

for shift in shifts_list:
    stack_key    = shift["from_stack"]
    shift_time   = shift["Time_Completed"]
    shift_tier   = shift["from_tier"]
    from_section = shift["from_section"]
    to_section   = shift["to_section"]

    if not stack_key:
        # Cannot evaluate without a parsed stack → HouseKeeping
        shift_categories[shift["mve_gkey"]] = "HouseKeeping"
        continue

    matched = False

    for load in load_by_stack.get(stack_key, []):
        load_time = load["Time_Completed"]
        load_tier = load["from_tier"]

        # Condition 1: Load must come AFTER the shift
        if load_time <= shift_time:
            continue

        # Condition 2: Must be within threshold window
        if (load_time - shift_time).total_seconds() > THRESHOLD_SECONDS:
            continue

        # Condition 3: Shift tier must be HIGHER than load tier
        if shift_tier is None or load_tier is None or shift_tier <= load_tier:
            continue

        # ── Conditions 1+2+3 met → determine Rehandle or HouseKeeping_01
        if from_section and to_section and from_section == to_section:
            # Same section → Rehandle (pair with load)
            category = "Rehandle"

            ca = shift["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
            cb = load["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
            wa = shift["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]
            wb = load["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]

            rehandle_pairs.append({
                # ── Record type ───────────────────────────────
                "record_type"            : "LOAD",

                # ── Load Info ─────────────────────────────────
                "mve_gkey_load"          : int(load["mve_gkey"]),
                "load_unit_nbr"          : load["Unit_Nbr"],
                "carrier_visit_key"      : int(cb) if cb else None,
                "load_from_stack"        : load["from_stack"],
                "load_from_section"      : load["from_section"],
                "load_from_position"     : load["From_Position_Name"],
                "load_tier"              : load_tier,
                "load_tier_letter"       : load["from_tier_letter"],
                "load_time"              : load_time,
                "load_date"              : load_time.date() if load_time else None,
                "load_week"              : load_time.strftime('%G-W%V') if load_time else None,
                "load_weight_kg"         : float(wb) if wb else None,
                "load_freight_kind"      : load["Freight_Kind_Id"],
                "load_category_id"       : load["Category_Id"],
                "load_pow"               : load["pow"],

                # ── Shift Info ────────────────────────────────
                "mve_gkey_shift"         : int(shift["mve_gkey"]),
                "shift_unit_nbr"         : shift["Unit_Nbr"],
                "shift_event_type"       : shift["Event_Type_Id"],
                "shift_from_stack"       : stack_key,
                "shift_from_section"     : from_section,
                "shift_from_tier"        : shift_tier,
                "shift_from_tier_letter" : shift["from_tier_letter"],
                "shift_to_section"       : to_section,
                "shift_to_position"      : shift["To_Position_Name"],
                "shift_time"             : shift_time,
                "shift_weight_kg"        : float(wa) if wa else None,
                "shift_freight_kind"     : shift["Freight_Kind_Id"],
                "shift_category_id"      : shift["Category_Id"],
                "shift_pow"              : shift["pow"],

                # ── Classification ────────────────────────────
                "category"               : category,
                "has_rehandle"           : True,
                "tier_difference"        : shift_tier - load_tier,
                "time_diff_seconds"      : int((load_time - shift_time).total_seconds()),
                "section_changed"        : False,
            })

            matched_load_keys.add(load["mve_gkey"])

        else:
            # Different section → HouseKeeping_01 (standalone, no load pairing)
            category = "HouseKeeping_01"

        shift_categories[shift["mve_gkey"]] = category
        matched_shift_keys.add(shift["mve_gkey"])
        matched = True
        break  # Each shift is evaluated against first valid load only

    if not matched:
        # No qualifying load found → HouseKeeping
        shift_categories[shift["mve_gkey"]] = "HouseKeeping"

# ─── Step 4: Standalone LOADs (no rehandle linked) ───────────
standalone_loads = []
for load in loads_list:
    if load["mve_gkey"] in matched_load_keys:
        continue  # Already appears in a rehandle pair

    cb = load["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
    t  = load["Time_Completed"]

    standalone_loads.append({
        "record_type"            : "LOAD",

        "mve_gkey_load"          : int(load["mve_gkey"]),
        "load_unit_nbr"          : load["Unit_Nbr"],
        "carrier_visit_key"      : int(cb) if cb else None,
        "load_from_stack"        : load["from_stack"],
        "load_from_section"      : load["from_section"],
        "load_from_position"     : load["From_Position_Name"],
        "load_tier"              : load["from_tier"],
        "load_tier_letter"       : load["from_tier_letter"],
        "load_time"              : t,
        "load_date"              : t.date() if t else None,
        "load_week"              : t.strftime('%G-W%V') if t else None,
        "load_weight_kg"         : float(load["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]) if load["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"] else None,
        "load_freight_kind"      : load["Freight_Kind_Id"],
        "load_category_id"       : load["Category_Id"],
        "load_pow"               : load["pow"],

        "mve_gkey_shift"         : None,
        "shift_unit_nbr"         : None,
        "shift_event_type"       : None,
        "shift_from_stack"       : None,
        "shift_from_section"     : None,
        "shift_from_tier"        : None,
        "shift_from_tier_letter" : None,
        "shift_to_section"       : None,
        "shift_to_position"      : None,
        "shift_time"             : None,
        "shift_weight_kg"        : None,
        "shift_freight_kind"     : None,
        

        "category"               : None,
        "has_rehandle"           : False,
        "tier_difference"        : None,
        "time_diff_seconds"      : None,
        "section_changed"        : None,
    })

# ─── Step 5: All non-rehandle shifts (HouseKeeping + HouseKeeping_01) ───
housekeeping_shifts = []
for shift in shifts_list:
    category = shift_categories.get(shift["mve_gkey"], "HouseKeeping")

    if category == "Rehandle":
        continue  # Already in rehandle_pairs

    ca = shift["Carrier_Visit_Key"]
    t  = shift["Time_Completed"]

    housekeeping_shifts.append({
        "record_type"            : "SHIFT",

        # ── Load Info (all null) ───────────────────────────────
        "mve_gkey_load"          : None,
        "load_unit_nbr"          : None,
        "carrier_visit_key"      : int(ca) if ca else None,
        "load_from_stack"        : None,
        "load_from_section"      : None,
        "load_from_position"     : None,
        "load_tier"              : None,
        "load_tier_letter"       : None,
        "load_time"              : None,
        "load_date"              : None,
        "load_week"              : None,
        "load_weight_kg"         : None,
        "load_freight_kind"      : None,

        # ── Shift Info ────────────────────────────────────────
        "mve_gkey_shift"         : int(shift["mve_gkey"]),
        "shift_unit_nbr"         : shift["Unit_Nbr"],
        "shift_event_type"       : shift["Event_Type_Id"],
        "shift_from_stack"       : shift["from_stack"],
        "shift_from_section"     : shift["from_section"],
        "shift_from_tier"        : shift["from_tier"],
        "shift_from_tier_letter" : shift["from_tier_letter"],
        "shift_to_section"       : shift["to_section"],
        "shift_to_position"      : shift["To_Position_Name"],
        "shift_time"             : t,
        "shift_weight_kg"        : float(shift["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"]) if shift["Goods_And_Ctr_Wt_Kg"] else None,
        "shift_freight_kind"     : shift["Freight_Kind_Id"],
        "shift_category_id"      : shift["Category_Id"],
        "shift_pow"               : shift["pow"],

        # ── Classification ────────────────────────────────────
        "category"               : category,
        "has_rehandle"           : False,
        "tier_difference"        : None,
        "time_diff_seconds"      : None,
        "section_changed"        : shift["from_section"] != shift["to_section"]
                                   if (shift["from_section"] and shift["to_section"]) else None,
    })

# ─── Step 6: Combine all rows ─────────────────────────────────
results = rehandle_pairs + standalone_loads + housekeeping_shifts

# ─── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
rehandle_count  = sum(1 for r in rehandle_pairs)
hk01_count      = sum(1 for r in housekeeping_shifts if r["category"] == "HouseKeeping_01")
hk_count        = sum(1 for r in housekeeping_shifts if r["category"] == "HouseKeeping")

print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"✅ RESULTS SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*50}")
print(f"   Total Loads              : {len(loads_list):,}")
print(f"     - With Rehandle(s)     : {rehandle_count:,}")
print(f"     - No Rehandle          : {len(standalone_loads):,}")
print(f"   Total Shifts             : {len(shifts_list):,}")
print(f"     - Rehandle             : {rehandle_count:,}")
print(f"     - HouseKeeping_01      : {hk01_count:,}")
print(f"     - HouseKeeping         : {hk_count:,}")
print(f"{'='*50}")
print(f"   OUTPUT ROWS              : {len(results):,}")

# ============================================================
# CELL 7 — Write to Gold Delta Table
# ============================================================

from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql.types import *

# ─── Schema ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
schema = StructType([
    # ── Record Type ──────────────────────────────────────────
    StructField("record_type",            StringType(),    True),  # LOAD / SHIFT

    # ── Load Info ────────────────────────────────────────────
    StructField("mve_gkey_load",          LongType(),      True),
    StructField("load_unit_nbr",               StringType(),    True),
    StructField("carrier_visit_key",      LongType(),      True),
    StructField("load_from_stack",        StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_from_section",      StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_from_position",     StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_tier",              IntegerType(),   True),
    StructField("load_tier_letter",       StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_time",              TimestampType(), True),
    StructField("load_date",              DateType(),      True),
    StructField("load_week",              StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_weight_kg",         DoubleType(),    True),
    StructField("load_freight_kind",      StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_category_id",       StringType(),    True),
    StructField("load_pow",               StringType(),    True),

    # ── Shift Info ───────────────────────────────────────────
    StructField("mve_gkey_shift",         LongType(),      True),
    StructField("shift_unit_nbr",         StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_event_type",       StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_from_stack",       StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_from_section",     StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_from_tier",        IntegerType(),   True),
    StructField("shift_from_tier_letter", StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_to_section",       StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_to_position",      StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_time",             TimestampType(), True),
    StructField("shift_weight_kg",        DoubleType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_freight_kind",     StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_category_id",      StringType(),    True),
    StructField("shift_pow",              StringType(),    True),

    # ── Classification ───────────────────────────────────────
    StructField("category",               StringType(),    True),  # Rehandle / HouseKeeping_01 / HouseKeeping / null
    StructField("has_rehandle",           BooleanType(),   True),
    StructField("tier_difference",        IntegerType(),   True),
    StructField("time_diff_seconds",      IntegerType(),   True),
    StructField("section_changed",        BooleanType(),   True),
])

# ─── Convert Python list → Spark DataFrame ───────────────────
df_results = spark.createDataFrame(results, schema=schema)

# ─── Write to Gold Delta ──────────────────────────────────────
try:
    if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, OUTPUT_DELTA):
        print(f"✅ Gold table exists — overwriting")
    else:
        print(f"📦 Gold table does not exist — creating new table")

    df_results.write \
        .format("delta") \
        .mode("overwrite") \
        .option("overwriteSchema", "true") \
        .save(OUTPUT_DELTA)

    print(f"✅ Gold table written to : {OUTPUT_DELTA}")
    print(f"📊 Records written       : {df_results.count():,}")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"❌ Failed to write to Gold: {str(e)}")
    raise

# ============================================================
# CELL 9 — Register Table & Verify
# ============================================================

spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db")

spark.sql(f"""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rehandles_db.rehandle_details_mft
    USING DELTA LOCATION '{OUTPUT_DELTA}'
""")

print("✅ Registered → rehandles_db.rehandle_details_mft")

# ─── Verify & Show Sample ────────────────────────────────────
df_check = spark.read.format("delta").load(OUTPUT_DELTA)
print(f"\n📋 rehandle_details_mft: {df_check.count():,} rows × {len(df_check.columns)} cols")

# Show category breakdown
print("\n📊 Category Breakdown:")
df_check.groupBy("category").count().orderBy(F.desc("count")).show()

# Show sample records
print("\n📋 Sample Records:")
df_check.select(
    "unit_nbr_shift", "shift_from_stack", "shift_from_tier_letter",
    "shift_to_section", "load_tier_letter", "category", "tier_difference"
).show(10, truncate=False)

# ============================================================
# CELL 10 — Analysis Queries (Optional)
# ============================================================

# Rehandles by Section
print("📊 Rehandles by Section:")
df_check.filter(F.col("category") == "Rehandle") \
    .groupBy("shift_from_section") \
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rehandle_count"),
        F.avg("tier_difference").alias("avg_tier_diff"),
        F.avg("time_diff_seconds").alias("avg_time_diff_sec")
    ) \
    .orderBy(F.desc("rehandle_count")) \
    .show(20)

# Rehandles by Week
print("📊 Rehandles by Week:")
df_check.filter(F.col("category") == "Rehandle") \
    .groupBy("shift_week") \
    .count() \
    .orderBy("shift_week") \
    .show(20)

# Replace 'youraccountname' with the real name of your storage account
delta_table_path = "abfss://cmatk@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/rehandle"

# This should now run without the 'Illegal character' error
display(spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE HISTORY delta.`{delta_table_path}`"))

%%sql
RESTORE TABLE delta.`abfss://cmatk@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/rehandle`
TO VERSION AS OF 1

from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    col, when, lit, substring, regexp_extract,
    trim, concat, expr
)

def parse_position(df, input_col, output_prefix, yard_config, vessel_config,
                   truck_config=None, rail_config=None):
    """
    Parses a position column into structured components.

    Reads terminal-specific regex patterns and metadata from TERMINAL_CONFIG
    and builds PySpark expressions dynamically.

    Both Malta and GPA have identical group structure:
        Group 1 → terminal code (e.g. MFT, GCT) — skipped via group_offset = 1
        Group 2 → Bay
        Group 3 → Row
        Group 4 → Tier
        Group 5 → Height/Tier value (raw)

    Malta example : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F  → separator = ' ', tier_type = 'letter'
    GPA example   : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3   → separator = '.', tier_type = 'number'

    Truck positions support multiple formats (GPA):
        Pattern 1 (TIP)        : T-{ID}-TIP-{letter}   → T-3004272-TIP-Y
        Pattern 2 (suffix)     : T-{ID}-{letter} (OUT) → T-3001804-Y (OUT)
        Pattern 3 (num_suffix) : T-{ID}-{number} (*)   → T-600-2 (TIP)
        Pattern 4 (plain)      : T-{ID} or T-{ID} (*)  → T-3001804, T-2978170 (OUT)
        Pattern 5 (text)       : T-{text_underscore}   → T-GEN_TRUCK

    group_offset = 1 for both Malta and GPA since both have a leading
    terminal code capture group before the actual position data.
    If a future terminal has NO leading group, set group_offset = 0.

    Args:
        df            : Input DataFrame
        input_col     : Source column name ('unit_position' or 'wi_position')
        output_prefix : Prefix for all output columns
        yard_config   : yard_position dict from TERMINAL_CONFIG
        vessel_config : vessel_position dict from TERMINAL_CONFIG
        truck_config  : Optional truck_position dict from TERMINAL_CONFIG
        rail_config   : Optional rail_position dict from TERMINAL_CONFIG

    Output columns added:
        {output_prefix}_type     → Position type first character: Y, V, T, R
        {output_prefix}_1        → Bay / Equipment ID
        {output_prefix}_2        → Bay.Row / ID-Suffix
        {output_prefix}_3        → Bay.Row.Tier (yard/vessel only)
        {output_prefix}_4        → Raw tier/height value (yard/vessel/truck TIP only)
        {output_prefix}_tier_num → Tier as integer
                                   letter tier : ascii(X) - ascii('A') + 1
                                   number tier : cast as int
                                   truck/rail  : fixed 0

    Verified against:
        Malta : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F   → _1=1A,        _2=1A 003,      _3=1A 003 02C, _4=F,   tier_num=6
        GPA   : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3    → _1=108,       _2=108.030,     _3=108.030.E,  _4=3,   tier_num=3
        Truck : T-3004272-TIP-Y      → _1=3004272,   _2=3004272-TIP,                _4=Y,   tier_num=0
        Truck : T-3001804-Y (OUT)    → _1=3001804,   _2=3001804-Y,                  _4='',  tier_num=0
        Truck : T-600-2 (TIP)        → _1=600,       _2=600-2,                      _4='',  tier_num=0
        Truck : T-2978170 (OUT)      → _1=2978170,   _2=2978170,                    _4='',  tier_num=0
        Truck : T-GEN_TRUCK          → _1=GEN_TRUCK, _2=GEN_TRUCK,                  _4='',  tier_num=0
        Rail  : R-CP527008-AB1       → _1=CP527008,  _2=CP527008-AB1,               _4='',  tier_num=0
    """

    separator  = yard_config.get('separator', ' ')
    yard_pfx   = yard_config['prefix']
    vessel_pfx = vessel_config['prefix']
    vessel_rx  = vessel_config['regex']

    # ── Resolve yard regex patterns & group_offset ────────────────
    # group_offset shifts all regex group reads past the leading
    # terminal code capture group present in both Malta and GPA.
    #
    # Malta regex_full: ^Y-([A-Z0-9]+)-([A-Z0-9]+)\s([A-Z0-9]+)\s([A-Z0-9]+)([A-Z])$
    #                       group1=MFT   group2=Bay   group3=Row   group4=Tier  group5=F
    #
    # GPA   regex_full: ^Y-([A-Z0-9]+)-([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([A-Z])\.([0-9]+)$
    #                       group1=GCT   group2=Bay group3=Row group4=Tier group5=3
    #
    # Both → group_offset = 1, data starts at group 2
    # The if/else only resolves which regex strings to use.

    if 'patterns' in yard_config:
        # Multi-pattern terminal (e.g. GPA)
        yard_regex_full  = yard_config['patterns'][0]['regex']
        yard_regex_short = next(
            (p['regex'] for p in yard_config['patterns'] if p['name'] == 'simple_location'),
            yard_config['patterns'][-1]['regex']
        )
        group_offset = 1  # GPA: group 1 = terminal code, data starts at group 2
    else:
        # Single-pattern terminal (e.g. Malta)
        yard_regex_full  = yard_config['regex_full']
        yard_regex_short = yard_config['regex_short']
        group_offset = 1  # Malta: group 1 = terminal code, data starts at group 2

    # ── Resolve truck regex patterns ──────────────────────────────
    # Five patterns evaluated in order — first match wins:
    #   truck_rx            : T-{ID}-TIP-{letter}   strict TIP with lane letter
    #   truck_rx_suffix     : T-{ID}-{letter} (*)   letter suffix before optional tag
    #   truck_rx_num_suffix : T-{ID}-{number} (*)   number suffix before optional tag
    #   truck_rx_plain      : T-{ID} or T-{ID} (*)  plain ID with optional tag in parens
    #   truck_rx_text       : T-{text_underscore}   text ID with underscores
    truck_pfx           = truck_config['prefix']                    if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx            = truck_config.get('regex',            '')  if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx_suffix     = truck_config.get('regex_suffix',     '')  if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx_num_suffix = truck_config.get('regex_num_suffix', '')  if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx_plain      = truck_config.get('regex_plain',      '')  if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx_text       = truck_config.get('regex_text',       '')  if truck_config else ''
    truck_rx_num_letter = truck_config.get('regex_num_letter', '') if truck_config else ''


    # ── Resolve rail regex pattern ────────────────────────────────
    rail_pfx = rail_config['prefix']         if rail_config else ''
    rail_rx  = rail_config.get('regex', '')  if rail_config else ''

    c = trim(col(input_col))  # trimmed column reference, reused throughout

    # ── Position Type ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    # First character identifies position type: Y=Yard, V=Vessel, T=Truck, R=Rail
    df = df.withColumn(
        f"{output_prefix}_type",
        substring(c, 1, 1)
    )

    # ── Position 1: Bay / Equipment ID ────────────────────────────
    # Yard full  → group (1 + offset) = Bay
    #   Malta    : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F → 1A
    #   GPA      : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3  → 108
    # Yard short → group (1 + offset) = Block/Location code
    # Vessel     → first 2 chars of group 2
    # Truck P1   : T-{ID}-TIP-{letter}   → ID
    # Truck P2   : T-{ID}-{letter} (*)   → ID
    # Truck P3   : T-{ID}-{number} (*)   → ID
    # Truck P4   : T-{ID} or T-{ID} (*)  → ID
    # Truck P5   : T-{text_underscore}   → text ID
    # Rail       : group 1 = operator/track code
    pos1 = (
        when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") > 0),
            regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 1 + group_offset)
        )
        .when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") == 0),
            regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_short, 1 + group_offset)
        )
        .when(
            c.startswith(vessel_pfx),
            substring(regexp_extract(c, vessel_rx, 2), 1, 2)
        )
    )
    if truck_config:
        if truck_rx:            pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            1))
        if truck_rx_suffix:     pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_suffix,     1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_suffix,     1))
        if truck_rx_num_letter: pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 1))
        if truck_rx_num_suffix: pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_suffix, 1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_suffix, 1))
        if truck_rx_plain:      pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_plain,      1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_plain,      1))
        if truck_rx_text:       pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_text,       1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_text,       1))


    if rail_config:
        pos1 = pos1.when(c.startswith(rail_pfx), regexp_extract(c, rail_rx, 1))

    df = df.withColumn(f"{output_prefix}_1", pos1.otherwise(lit('')))

    # ── Position 2: Bay.Row / ID-Suffix ───────────────────────────
    # Yard full  → "Bay{sep}Row"
    #   Malta    : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F → "1A 003"
    #   GPA      : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3  → "108.030"
    # Yard short → same as position 1 (only block/location known)
    # Vessel     → full slot string from group 2
    # Truck P1   : T-{ID}-TIP-{letter}   → ID-TIP
    # Truck P2   : T-{ID}-{letter} (*)   → ID-{letter}
    # Truck P3   : T-{ID}-{number} (*)   → ID-{number}
    # Truck P4   : T-{ID} or T-{ID} (*)  → ID only (no suffix to append)
    # Truck P5   : T-{text_underscore}   → text ID only
    # Rail       : "group1-group2"
    pos2 = (
        when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") > 0),
            concat(
                regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 1 + group_offset),
                lit(separator),
                regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 2 + group_offset)
            )
        )
        .when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") == 0),
            regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_short, 1 + group_offset)
        )
        .when(
            c.startswith(vessel_pfx),
            regexp_extract(c, vessel_rx, 2)
        )
    )
    if truck_config:
        if truck_rx:            pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            1) != ''), concat(regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            1), lit('-'), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            2)))
        if truck_rx_suffix:     pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_suffix,     1) != ''), concat(regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_suffix,     1), lit('-'), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_suffix,     2)))
        if truck_rx_num_letter: pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 1) != ''), concat(regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 1), lit('-'), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 2)))
        if truck_rx_num_suffix: pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_suffix, 1) != ''), concat(regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_suffix, 1), lit('-'), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_suffix, 2)))
        if truck_rx_plain:      pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_plain,      1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_plain,      1))
        if truck_rx_text:       pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_text,       1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_text,       1))


    if rail_config:
        pos2 = pos2.when(c.startswith(rail_pfx), concat(regexp_extract(c, rail_rx, 1), lit('-'), regexp_extract(c, rail_rx, 2)))

    df = df.withColumn(f"{output_prefix}_2", pos2.otherwise(lit('')))

    # ── Position 3: Bay.Row.Tier ───────────────────────────────────
    # Yard full  → "Bay{sep}Row{sep}Tier"
    #   Malta    : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F → "1A 003 02C"
    #   GPA      : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3  → "108.030.E"
    # Yard short → no tier known, falls through to otherwise('')
    # Vessel     → first 4 chars of group 2 (Bay+Row portion)
    # Truck      → '' (no tier concept)
    # Rail       → '' (no tier concept)
    pos3 = (
        when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") > 0),
            concat(
                regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 1 + group_offset),
                lit(separator),
                regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 2 + group_offset),
                lit(separator),
                regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 3 + group_offset)
            )
        )
        .when(
            c.startswith(vessel_pfx),
            substring(regexp_extract(c, vessel_rx, 2), 1, 4)
        )
    )
    if truck_config: pos3 = pos3.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx), lit(''))
    if rail_config:  pos3 = pos3.when(c.startswith(rail_pfx),  lit(''))
    df = df.withColumn(f"{output_prefix}_3", pos3.otherwise(lit('')))

    # ── Position 4: Raw Tier / Height value ───────────────────────
    # Yard full  → group (4 + offset) = raw tier value
    #   Malta    : Y-MFT-1A 003 02C F → "F"  (letter → tier_num=6)
    #   GPA      : Y-GCT-108.030.E.3  → "3"  (number → tier_num=3)
    # Vessel     → last 2 chars of group 2
    # Truck P1   : T-{ID}-TIP-{letter} → lane letter e.g. "Y"
    # Truck P2-5 : '' (no tier/lane info available)
    # Rail       → '' (no tier)
    pos4 = (
        when(
            (c.startswith(yard_pfx)) & (expr(f"locate('{separator}', trim({input_col}))") > 0),
            regexp_extract(c, yard_regex_full, 4 + group_offset)
        )
        .when(
            c.startswith(vessel_pfx),
            expr(f"right(regexp_extract(trim({input_col}), '{vessel_rx}', 2), 2)")
        )
    )
    if truck_config:
        if truck_rx:            pos4 = pos4.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx,            3))
        if truck_rx_num_letter: pos4 = pos4.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx) & (regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 1) != ''), regexp_extract(c, truck_rx_num_letter, 3))
        pos4 = pos4.when(c.startswith(truck_pfx), lit(''))  # all other patterns → ''


    if rail_config:
        pos4 = pos4.when(c.startswith(rail_pfx), lit(''))

    df = df.withColumn(f"{output_prefix}_4", pos4.otherwise(lit('')))

    # ── Tier Number: convert raw tier to integer ───────────────────
    # letter tier (Malta): ascii arithmetic → "A"=1, "B"=2 ... "F"=6
    # number tier (GPA)  : direct cast     → "3"=3
    # Vessel             : always numeric cast
    # Truck / Rail       : fixed 0 (no stacking concept)
    tier_type = yard_config.get('tier_type', 'number')
    yard_tier = (
        expr(f"ascii({output_prefix}_4) - ascii('A') + 1")
        if tier_type == 'letter'
        else col(f"{output_prefix}_4").cast("int")
    )

    tier = (
        when(
            (col(f"{output_prefix}_type") == yard_pfx) & (col(f"{output_prefix}_4") != ''),
            yard_tier
        )
        .when(
            (col(f"{output_prefix}_type") == vessel_pfx) & (col(f"{output_prefix}_4") != ''),
            col(f"{output_prefix}_4").cast("int")
        )
    )
    if truck_config: tier = tier.when(col(f"{output_prefix}_type") == truck_pfx, lit(0))
    if rail_config:  tier = tier.when(col(f"{output_prefix}_type") == rail_pfx,  lit(0))

  
    base_prefix = output_prefix.split('_')[0]
    df = df.withColumn(f"{base_prefix}_tier_num", tier.otherwise(lit(0)))


    return df

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW deduplicated AS

SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY integration_key 
        ORDER BY source_file_name_sort DESC, wi_modified DESC
    ) AS row_number
FROM with_derived
WHERE integration_key IS NOT NULL

# Pattern: _ddMMyyyy_HHmm.txt

import re

def extract_file_datetime(file_name: str):
    match = re.search(
        r'_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{4})_(\d{4})\.txt$',
        file_name, re.IGNORECASE
    )
    if not match:
        return None, None
    dd, mm, yyyy, hhmm = match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3), match.group(4)
    datetime_str = f"{yyyy}-{mm}-{dd} {hhmm[:2]}:{hhmm[2:]}:00"
    sort_long    = int(f"{yyyy}{mm}{dd}{hhmm}")
    return datetime_str, sort_long

def validate_coverage(parsed_rows: list, col_map: dict) -> None:
    total = len(parsed_rows)
    zero  = []
    print(f"\n{'─'*68}")
    print(f"{'GPA Code':<8} {'Output Column':<28} {'Non-Null':>8}  {'%':>7}")

# ============================================================
# PARSER  — CRITICAL FIX
#
# KEY FIX: Empty string "" treated as None after merge.
# The V3 HTML converter uses "last wins" — we use "first
# non-empty wins" which is safer for merging 9 lines/EQID.
#
# Each line in the TXT starts with EQID: so the EQID check
# is correct. But empty string values from later lines must
# NOT overwrite non-empty values from earlier lines.
# ============================================================
from collections import defaultdict

RE_FIELD = re.compile(r'^([A-Z]{4}):\s?(.*)$')

def parse_gpa_file(raw_text: str, col_map: dict) -> tuple:
    """
    Parse GPA TXT — merge all lines by EQID.
    First non-empty value wins for each field.
    Each line starts with EQID: followed by tab-separated KEY: VALUE pairs.
    """
    expected_keys    = set(col_map.keys()) | {"EQID"}
    recs             = {}   # eqid → merged dict
    order            = []
    eqid_line_counts = defaultdict(int)
    total_lines  = 0
    skip_header  = 0
    skip_empty   = 0
    skip_no_eqid = 0

    for ln in raw_text.split('\n'):
        ln = ln.rstrip('\r')

        # Skip blank lines
        if not ln.strip():
            skip_empty += 1
            continue

        # Skip comment/header lines
        if ln.startswith('#') or ln.startswith('//'):
            skip_header += 1
            continue

        # Only process lines that start with EQID:
        if not ln.startswith('EQID:'):
            skip_no_eqid += 1
            continue

        total_lines += 1

        # Split by tab and parse each KEY: VALUE token
        tokens = ln.split('\t')
        row    = {}
        for tok in tokens:
            tok = tok.strip()
            m   = RE_FIELD.match(tok)
            if m:
                key   = m.group(1)
                value = m.group(2).strip()
                # Only capture keys we care about
                if key in expected_keys:
                    # ✅ Store value only if non-empty, else None
                    row[key] = value if value else None

        eqid = row.get('EQID')
        if not eqid:
            skip_no_eqid += 1
            continue

        eqid_line_counts[eqid] += 1

        if eqid not in recs:
            # First line for this EQID — initialise all fields to None
            recs[eqid] = {k: None for k in col_map.keys()}
            order.append(eqid)

        # ✅ FIRST NON-EMPTY WINS — never overwrite a populated field
        existing = recs[eqid]
        for k, v in row.items():
            if k in existing and v is not None and existing[k] is None:
                existing[k] = v

    result_rows = list(recs[eqid] for eqid in order)

    line_dist = defaultdict(int)
    for c in eqid_line_counts.values():
        line_dist[c] += 1

    stats = {
        "total_lines"        : total_lines,
        "unique_eqids"       : len(result_rows),
        "skip_header"        : skip_header,
        "skip_empty"         : skip_empty,
        "skip_no_eqid"       : skip_no_eqid,
        "avg_lines_per_eqid" : round(total_lines / max(len(result_rows), 1), 2),
        "line_distribution"  : dict(sorted(line_dist.items())),
    }
    return result_rows, stats


def extract_declared_columns(raw_text: str) -> tuple:
    """Extract field names from #ListFromUserFilter header lines."""
    declared     = []
    seen         = set()
    filter_count = 0
    pattern      = re.compile(
        r'#ListFromUserFilter\(\s*\w+\s*,(.+?)\)', re.IGNORECASE
    )
    for line in raw_text.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        match = pattern.match(line)
        if not match:
            continue
        filter_count += 1
        for f in [f.strip() for f in match.group(1).split(',')]:
            if f and f not in seen:
                declared.append(f)
                seen.add(f)
    return declared, filter_count

                                    (F.col("source_file_name") == file_name) &
                                    (F.col("client_id") == client_id)
                                ) \
                                .limit(1) \
                                .count()
            if existing_count > 0:
                silver_exists = True
                print(f"⚠️  Found in Silver   : '{file_name}' already processed for '{client_id}'")

        # ── Check 2 : Archive folder ─────────────────────────────
        archive_exists = False
        try:
            archived_files = [f.name for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(bronze_archive_path)]
            if file_name in archived_files:
                archive_exists = True
                print(f"⚠️  Found in Archive  : '{file_name}' already archived")
        except Exception:
            pass  # Archive folder may not exist yet — non-fatal

        # ── Decision ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        if silver_exists or archive_exists:
            already_processed = True
            reason = []
            if silver_exists: reason.append("Silver")
            if archive_exists: reason.append("Archive")
            print(f"\n🔴 DUPLICATE DETECTED via: {' + '.join(reason)}")
            print(f"   Moving to duplicate folder instead of processing...")

            try:
                mssparkutils.fs.mv(
                    file_path,
                    f"{bronze_duplicate_path}{file_name}",
                    True
                )
                print(f"📁 Moved to duplicate : {bronze_duplicate_path}{file_name}")
            except Exception as dup_move_err:
                # If duplicate folder already has this file too
                print(f"⚠️  Could not move to duplicate folder: {dup_move_err}")
                print(f"   Attempting to remove from bronze instead...")
                try:
                    mssparkutils.fs.rm(file_path, False)
                    print(f"🗑️  Removed from bronze: {file_name}")
                except Exception as rm_err:
                    print(f"⚠️  Could not remove from bronze (non-fatal): {rm_err}")
        else:
            print(f"✅ File not found in Silver or Archive — safe to process")

    except Exception as guard_err:
        print(f"⚠️  Idempotency check failed (non-fatal): {guard_err}")
        already_processed = False

    if already_processed:
        continue  # ← Skip all processing steps for this file


    try:

                # ── Alternative: Read full file via Spark ─────────────────────
        # This avoids the size limit of fs.head() entirely

        from pyspark.sql import functions as F

        # Read as single string per file
        raw_rdd  = spark.sparkContext.wholeTextFiles(file_path)
        raw_text = raw_rdd.first()[1]   # (path, content) → take content
        print(f"✅ Read {len(raw_text):,} chars  ({len(raw_text)/1024/1024:.1f} MB)")


        # ── STEP 2 : Extract datetime from filename ──────────
        file_datetime_str, source_file_sort = extract_file_datetime(file_name)
        if file_datetime_str:
            print(f"✅ File datetime : {file_datetime_str}  (sort={source_file_sort})")
        else:
            print(f"⚠️  No datetime in filename — using current_timestamp()")
            source_file_sort = 0
                # ── Derive file_date_str from file_datetime_str ──────────────
        if file_datetime_str:
            # file_datetime_str format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
            file_date_str = file_datetime_str[:10]   # → "yyyy-MM-dd"
        else:
            # Fallback: use today's date
            file_date_str = datetime.date.today().isoformat()

        print(f"✅ file_date_str  : {file_date_str}")


        # ── STEP 3 : QA — declared columns ───────────────────
        declared_cols, filter_count = extract_declared_columns(raw_text)
        not_mapped  = set(declared_cols) - set(COLUMN_MAP.keys())
        not_in_file = set(COLUMN_MAP.keys()) - set(declared_cols)
        print(f"✅ Filter lines  : {filter_count}")
        print(f"✅ Declared cols : {len(declared_cols)}")
        if not_mapped:
            print(f"   ℹ️  In file, not captured : {sorted(not_mapped)}")
        if not_in_file:
            print(f"   ⚠️  In map, not in file  : {sorted(not_in_file)}")

        # ── STEP 4 : Parse ───────────────────────────────────
        parsed_rows, stats = parse_gpa_file(raw_text, COLUMN_MAP)

        print(f"\n📊 Parse Stats:")
        print(f"   Raw data lines     : {stats['total_lines']:>8,}")
        print(f"   Unique containers  : {stats['unique_eqids']:>8,}")
        print(f"   Avg lines/EQID     : {stats['avg_lines_per_eqid']:>8.2f}")
        print(f"   Skipped (header)   : {stats['skip_header']:>8,}")
        print(f"   Skipped (blank)    : {stats['skip_empty']:>8,}")
        print(f"   Skipped (no EQID)  : {stats['skip_no_eqid']:>8,}")

        print(f"\n📊 Lines-per-EQID Distribution:")
        for n, c in stats['line_distribution'].items():
            pct = (c / max(stats['unique_eqids'], 1)) * 100
            bar = "█" * min(c // max(stats['unique_eqids'] // 40, 1), 40)
            print(f"   {n:>2} lines → {c:>6,} containers ({pct:>5.1f}%)  {bar}")

        print(f"\n📋 Column Coverage:")
        validate_coverage(parsed_rows, COLUMN_MAP)

        if not parsed_rows:
            print(f"⚠️  No rows parsed — skipping.")
            files_failed.append(file_name)
            continue

        # ── STEP 5 : Sample check before Spark ───────────────
        # Show first parsed row to verify data is populated
        sample = parsed_rows[0]
        populated = {k: v for k, v in sample.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"\n🔍 Sample row (first container):")
        print(f"   Populated fields : {len(populated)} / {len(COLUMN_MAP)}")
        for k, v in list(populated.items())[:10]:
            print(f"   {k:<8} = {v}")

        # ── STEP 6 : Build Spark DataFrame ───────────────────
        raw_schema = StructType([
            StructField(src, StringType(), True)
            for src in COLUMN_MAP.keys()
        ])
        df_raw = spark.createDataFrame(parsed_rows, schema=raw_schema)

        # ── STEP 7 : Rename + Cast (minimal, no APOD dynamic logic) ──
        INTEGER_COLS = {"actual_sequence", "queue_seq", "yard_crane_seq"}
        DOUBLE_COLS  = {"unit_vgm__kg"}

        df_typed = df_raw.select([
            F.trim(F.col(src_col)).cast(IntegerType()).alias(out_col)
            if out_col in INTEGER_COLS
            else F.trim(F.col(src_col)).cast(DoubleType()).alias(out_col)
            if out_col in DOUBLE_COLS
            else F.trim(F.col(src_col)).alias(out_col)
            for src_col, (out_col, _) in COLUMN_MAP.items()
        ])


        # ── STEP 10 : wi_created from filename datetime ───────
        # TIME field = "age" (dwell age string) — NOT a timestamp
        # wi_created comes purely from filename datetime
        if file_datetime_str:
            file_ts = F.to_timestamp(
                F.lit(file_datetime_str), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
            )
            print(f"✅ wi_created from filename: {file_datetime_str}")
        else:
            file_ts = F.current_timestamp()
            print(f"⚠️  wi_created fallback: current_timestamp()")

        df_typed = df_typed.withColumn("wi_created", file_ts)

        # ── STEP 11 : Derived columns ─────────────────────────

        # Equipment class
        equip_class_expr = F.coalesce(
            *[F.when(F.trim(F.col("unit_type_iso")) == k, F.lit(v))
              for k, v in equip_class_map.items()],
            F.col("unit_type_iso")
        )

        # Weight class
        weight_class_expr = F.lit(None).cast(StringType())
        for min_kg, wc_label in sorted(weight_class_thresholds, key=lambda x: x[0]):
            weight_class_expr = F.when(
                F.col("unit_vgm__kg").cast("double") >= min_kg,
                F.lit(wc_label)
            ).otherwise(weight_class_expr)

        # ALOG derivations
        move_category_expr = (
            F.when(F.split(F.col("assignment_logic"), "/").getItem(0) == "I",
                   F.lit("IMPORT"))
            .when(F.split(F.col("assignment_logic"), "/").getItem(0) == "R",
                  F.lit("RESTOW"))
            .when(F.split(F.col("assignment_logic"), "/").getItem(0) == "%",
                  F.lit("EXPORT"))
            .otherwise(F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
        )

        crane_id_expr = F.when(
            F.split(F.col("assignment_logic"), "/").getItem(1)
             .rlike(r"^QC[0-9]+$"),
            F.split(F.col("assignment_logic"), "/").getItem(1)
        ).otherwise(F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))

        load_list_name_expr = F.regexp_extract(
            F.col("assignment_logic"), r"#(.+)$", 1
        )

        # unit_position_3 from pre-decomposed parts
        unit_pos_3_expr = F.concat_ws(
            ".",
            F.col("unit_position_1"),
            F.col("unit_position_2"),
            F.col("unit_tier_num"),
        )

        df_mapped = (
            df_typed
            .withColumn("equip_class",      equip_class_expr)
            .withColumn("weight_class",     weight_class_expr)
            .withColumn("move_category",    move_category_expr)
            .withColumn("crane_id",         crane_id_expr)
            .withColumn("load_list_name",   load_list_name_expr)
            .withColumn("unit_position_3",  unit_pos_3_expr)
            .withColumn("unit_tier_num",
                F.col("unit_tier_num").cast(IntegerType()))
            .withColumn("wi_modified",      F.col("wi_created"))
            .withColumn("stow_factor",
                F.concat_ws("-",
                    F.col("unit_o_b_actual_visit"),
                    F.col("unit_pod"),
                    F.col("unit_category"),
                    F.col("move_kind"),
                    F.col("equip_class"),
                    F.col("weight_class"),
                )
            )
            # Schema-compatibility nulls
            .withColumn("unit_stow",             F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_stow_2",           F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_stow_3",           F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("locked",                F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("twin_fetch",            F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("twin_carry",            F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_damage_severity",  F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_on_power",         F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_must_be_on_power", F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("unit_last_free_day",    F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("destination_position",  F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            .withColumn("dead_weight_tons",      F.lit(None).cast(StringType()))
            # Integration key + metadata
            .withColumn("integration_key",
                F.concat_ws("_",
                    F.trim(F.col("unit_nbr")),
                    F.col("move_kind"),
                    F.lit(file_name)
                )
            )
            .withColumn("client_id",             F.lit(client_id))
            .withColumn("client_key",            F.lit(client_key).cast(IntegerType()))
            .withColumn("load_timestamp",        F.current_timestamp())
            .withColumn("source_file_name",      F.lit(file_name))
            .withColumn("source_file_name_sort", F.lit(source_file_sort).cast("long"))
            .withColumn("year",                  F.year(F.col("wi_created")))
            .withColumn("month",                 F.month(F.col("wi_created")))
            .withColumn("week",                  F.weekofyear(F.col("wi_created")))
            .drop("equip_class", "weight_class")
        )
        # ============================================================
        # STEP 11c : Compute anchor date from min(time_until_move)
        # Skips ## corrupted values, uses file DATE only (not time)
        # ============================================================
        import datetime
        from pyspark.sql.types import StringType, IntegerType
        from pyspark.sql import functions as F

        DAY_ABBR_MAP = {"MO":0,"TU":1,"WE":2,"TH":3,"FR":4,"SA":5,"SU":6}

        def parse_ttmv(val):
            if not val or "#" in val: return None
            parts = val.strip().split(":")
            if len(parts) != 2: return None
            h, m = parts
            if not h.isdigit() or not m.isdigit() or int(m) > 59: return None
            return int(h) * 60 + int(m)

        parse_ttmv_udf = F.udf(parse_ttmv, IntegerType())

        df_mapped = df_mapped.withColumn("_ttmv_min", parse_ttmv_udf(F.col("time_until_move")))

        stats = df_mapped.agg(
            F.count("time_until_move").alias("total"),
            F.sum(F.when(F.col("time_until_move").contains("#"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("corrupted"),
            F.sum(F.when(F.col("_ttmv_min").isNotNull(), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("clean"),
            F.min("_ttmv_min").alias("min_mins"),
        ).collect()[0]

        print(f"📊 time_until_move — total:{stats.total:,} clean:{stats.clean:,} corrupted:{stats.corrupted:,}")

        file_date = datetime.date.fromisoformat(file_date_str)

        if stats.min_mins is not None:
            anchor_date = (
                datetime.datetime.combine(file_date, datetime.time(0,0))
                + datetime.timedelta(minutes=int(stats.min_mins))
            ).date()
            print(f"✅ Anchor: {file_date} + {stats.min_mins}min → {anchor_date} ({anchor_date.strftime('%A')})")
        else:
            anchor_date = file_date
            print(f"⚠️  No clean rows — fallback anchor: {anchor_date} ({anchor_date.strftime('%A')})")

        anchor_date_str = anchor_date.isoformat()
        anchor_wd       = anchor_date.weekday()

        # Resolution preview
        print(f"\n📅 Weekday resolution from anchor ({anchor_date.strftime('%A %d %b %Y')}):")
        for abbr, wd in DAY_ABBR_MAP.items():
            delta    = (wd - anchor_wd) % 7
            if delta > 5: delta -= 7
            resolved = anchor_date + datetime.timedelta(days=delta)
            print(f"   {abbr} → {resolved}  ({resolved.strftime('%A')})"
                + (" ← drift buffer" if delta == -1 else ""))
        # ============================================================
        # STEP 11d : Resolve est_mv_time / est_mv_hour / est_mv_quarter_hour
        # move_time null → est_mv_time null (handled automatically)
        # ============================================================

        def resolve_mv_time(val, anchor_str):
            if not val or not anchor_str: return None
            import datetime as _dt
            _DAYS = {"MO":0,"TU":1,"WE":2,"TH":3,"FR":4,"SA":5,"SU":6}
            v = val.strip().lstrip("+").upper()
            if len(v) != 6 or v[:2] not in _DAYS or not v[2:].isdigit(): return None
            hh, mm = int(v[2:4]), int(v[4:6])
            if hh > 23 or mm > 59: return None
            anchor = _dt.date.fromisoformat(anchor_str)
            delta  = ((_DAYS[v[:2]] - anchor.weekday()) % 7)
            if delta > 5: delta -= 7
            resolved = _dt.datetime.combine(
                anchor + _dt.timedelta(days=delta), _dt.time(hh, mm)
            )
            return resolved.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

        resolve_mv_udf = F.udf(resolve_mv_time, StringType())

        for src_col, out_col in [
            ("move_time",         "est_mv_time"),
            ("move_hour",         "est_mv_hour"),
            ("move_quarter_hour", "est_mv_quarter_hour"),
        ]:
            df_mapped = df_mapped.withColumn(
                out_col,
                F.to_timestamp(
                    resolve_mv_udf(F.col(src_col), F.lit(anchor_date_str)),
                    "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
                )
            )

        df_mapped = df_mapped.drop("_ttmv_min")

        print("✅ est_mv_time, est_mv_hour, est_mv_quarter_hour added")
        print(f"   Null move_time rows → est_mv_time will be null ✅")

        # Sanity check
        df_mapped.select("move_time","est_mv_time") \
            .filter(F.col("move_time").isNotNull()) \
            .distinct().orderBy("est_mv_time") \
            .show(20, truncate=False)


        # ── STEP 12 : Enforce fixed schema ───────────────────
        existing_cols = set(df_mapped.columns)
        for col_name in SILVER_COLUMNS:
            if col_name not in existing_cols:
                df_mapped = df_mapped.withColumn(
                    col_name, F.lit(None).cast(StringType())
                )

        silver_df = df_mapped.select(SILVER_COLUMNS)

        row_count = silver_df.count()
        print(f"\n✅ Silver rows    : {row_count:,}")
        print(f"✅ Silver columns : {len(silver_df.columns)}")

        # ── STEP 13 : Deduplication ───────────────────────────
        # window_spec = (
        #     Window
        #     .partitionBy("integration_key")
        #     .orderBy(
        #         F.desc("source_file_name_sort"),
        #         F.desc("wi_created")
        #     )
        # )

        # silver_deduped = (
        #     silver_df
        #     .filter(F.col("integration_key").isNotNull())
        #     .withColumn("_rn", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
        #     .filter(F.col("_rn") == 1)
        #     .drop("_rn")
        # )
        silver_deduped = (
                                silver_df
                                .filter(F.col("integration_key").isNotNull())
                                .dropDuplicates(["integration_key"])  # ✅ Correct — rows are truly identical
                        )


        deduped_count = silver_deduped.count()
        print(f"✅ After dedup    : {deduped_count:,} rows "
              f"({row_count - deduped_count:,} removed)")

                # ── STEP 14 : Write Silver (append, partitioned by client_id) ─────────
        spark.conf.set("spark.sql.sources.partitionOverwriteMode", "dynamic")

        if DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, silver_path):
            silver_deduped.write \
                .format("delta") \
                .mode("append") \
                .partitionBy("client_id") \
                .option("mergeSchema", "true") \
                .save(silver_path)
            print(f"✅ Silver: Appended {deduped_count:,} rows for '{client_id}'")
        else:
            silver_deduped.write \
                .format("delta") \
                .mode("overwrite") \
                .partitionBy("client_id") \
                .option("mergeSchema", "true") \
                .save(silver_path)
            print(f"✅ Silver: Created with {deduped_count:,} rows for '{client_id}'")

        # ── STEP 15 : REMOVED — No Gold table ────────────────────────────────
        # Power BI will connect to the Silver Delta table via the view below.


        # ── STEP 16 : Archive ─────────────────────────────────
        try:
            mssparkutils.fs.mv(
                file_path,
                f"{bronze_archive_path}{file_name}",
                True
            )
            print(f"📦 Archived: {file_name}")
        except Exception as arch_err:
            print(f"⚠️  Archive warning (non-fatal): {arch_err}")

        files_processed += 1

    except Exception as file_err:
        print(f"❌ Failed: {file_name}")
        print(f"   Type : {type(file_err).__name__}")
        print(f"   Error: {str(file_err)}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        files_failed.append(file_name)
        continue

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(f"\n{'='*65}")
print(f"📊 PIPELINE SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*65}")
print(f"   Files found     : {len(txt_files)}")
print(f"   Files processed : {files_processed}")
print(f"   Files failed    : {len(files_failed)}")
if files_failed:
    for ff in files_failed:
        print(f"   ❌ {ff}")
print(f"{'='*65}")

if files_processed == 0:
    raise RuntimeError("❌ No files processed.")

# ============================================================
# VERIFY AND FIX — run this cell to confirm and correct
# ============================================================

# 1. Check and fix COLUMN_MAP cast types
fields_to_check = {
    "SMHS": ("move_hour",         "string"),
    "SMQH": ("move_quarter_hour", "string"),
    "SMTS": ("move_time",         "string"),
    "TIME": ("age",               "string"),
    "DWTS": ("time_of_dwell",     "string"),
    "TTMV": ("time_until_move",   "integer"),  # this one IS integer
}

print("📋 Cast type verification:")
all_ok = True
for src, (expected_col, expected_type) in fields_to_check.items():
    if src in COLUMN_MAP:
        actual_col, actual_type = COLUMN_MAP[src]
        ok = (actual_type == expected_type)
        status = "✅" if ok else "❌ WRONG"
        if not ok:
            all_ok = False
        print(f"  {src:<8} → {actual_col:<25} "
              f"expected={expected_type:<10} "
              f"actual={actual_type:<10} {status}")
    else:
        print(f"  {src:<8} ❌ NOT IN COLUMN_MAP")

if not all_ok:
    print("\n⚠️  Fixing cast types in COLUMN_MAP...")
    for src, (col, cast) in fields_to_check.items():
        if src in COLUMN_MAP:
            COLUMN_MAP[src] = (col, cast)
    print("✅ Fixed")

# 2. Fix regex — use greedy match
RE_FIELD = re.compile(r'^([A-Z]{4}):\s*(.*)$')
print("\n✅ RE_FIELD updated to greedy match")

# 3. Verify on actual raw data
print("\n📋 Sample raw values for time fields:")
data_lines = [l.rstrip('\r') for l in raw_text.replace('\r\n','\n').split('\n')
              if l.startswith('EQID:')]

found = {"SMHS": [], "SMQH": [], "SMTS": []}
for line in data_lines:
    tokens = line.split('\t')
    for tok in tokens:
        tok_s = tok.strip()
        m = RE_FIELD.match(tok_s)
        if m and m.group(1) in found:
            val = m.group(2).strip()
            if val and len(found[m.group(1)]) < 5:
                found[m.group(1)].append(val)

for field, values in found.items():
    out_col = COLUMN_MAP.get(field, (field,))[0]
    print(f"  {field} ({out_col}): {values}")
